documents.title: Paging policy differentiation based on application characteristics
documents.text: The enhancement allows the paging policy to be differentiated based on the application characteristics known to and trusted by the serving network. The network can identify the traffic's application characteristics and differentiate the paging policies accordingly.

documents.title: Neighboring cells included in the measResultNeighCells field of the VarConnEstFailReport
documents.text: At most, 6 intra-frequency and 3 inter-frequency neighbors per frequency and 3 inter-RAT neighbors per frequency/set of frequencies (GERAN) per RAT should be included in measResultNeighCells. For each neighboring cell, the latest results of the available measurements as used for cell reselection evaluation, which are performed in accordance with the performance requirements as specified in TS 36.133, should be included.

documents.title: The RAN can send ANBR recommending UE transmission at an uplink bitrate
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.300 and TS 38.413 specifies that the RAN can send ANBR recommending UE transmission at an uplink bitrate R1 greater than the current rate R0 in the case of GBR bearer/GFBR flow and assuming GBR/GFBR < recommended bitrate < MBR/GFBR, or in the case of non-GBR bearer/non-GFBR flow.

documents.title: The maximum number of diversions permitted for each communication in the CD service and Communication Forwarding (CF) services
documents.text: The maximum number of diversions permitted for each communication is a network provider option for the CD service and a service provider option for the CF services. The service provider or network provider defines the upper limit of diversions, and when counting the number of diversions, all types of diversion are included.

documents.title: Purpose of the pre-established session between the MCPTT UE and the MCPTT server
documents.text: The pre-established session between the MCPTT UE and the MCPTT server is used to maintain the connection between the two, and it can be modified or removed by using the SIP procedures for session modification and terminating a SIP session.

documents.title: Definition of the abbreviation "IAB"
documents.text: IAB stands for Integrated Access and Backhaul.

documents.title: The focus of the Enhanced Performance Requirements Type A - Single-layer Spatial Multiplexing with TM9 interference model (User-Specific Reference Symbols) test
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.143 specifies that the focus of this test is to verify closed loop rank one performance on one of the antenna ports 7 or 8 without a simultaneous transmission on the other antenna port in the serving cell when the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of one dominant interfering cell applying transmission mode 9 interference model defined in clause B.5.4.

documents.title: Purpose of the "Register" message in the context of 3GPP technical specifications
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.080 specifies that the "Register" message is used to assign a new transaction identifier for call independent supplementary service control and to request or acknowledge a supplementary service.

documents.title: The NWDAF containing AnLF may use the rate of untrusted AF data
documents.text: The NWDAF containing AnLF may use the rate of untrusted AF data sources as a criterion to calculate the confidence level of the respective analytics output.

documents.title: Functions of the RLC/MAC layer in the GPRS radio interface
documents.text: The RLC/MAC layer provides services for information transfer over the physical layer in the GPRS radio interface. It includes backward error correction procedures enabled by the selective retransmission of erroneous blocks and arbitrates access to the shared medium between multiple MSs and the Network.

documents.title: The SS terminates the dialogue when the user ignores the location request
documents.text: The SS terminates the dialogue when the user ignores the location request by taking no action, allowing the verification process timer to time-out.

documents.title: The RNC should release locally the resources and references associated to the
documents.text: The RNC should release locally the resources and references associated to the Iu signalling connection identifiers indicated in the received message, and should return a RESET RESOURCE ACKNOWLEDGE message to the CN after all Iu-related resources and references have been released.

documents.title: Definition of the UE occupied bandwidth
documents.text: The UE occupied bandwidth is defined as the bandwidth containing 99 % of the total integrated mean power of the transmitted spectrum on the assigned channel at each transmit antenna connector.

documents.title: A dedicated APN is used for UAV connectivity to USS/UTM in EPC
documents.text: A dedicated APN is used for UAV connectivity to USS/UTM in EPC, and may also be used for UAV3/UAV5 connectivity. In 5GS, connectivity is established via the UFES to the USS/UTM.

documents.title: The general requirements specified for the Service Enabler Architecture Layer (SEAL)
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.434 specifies that the general requirements for SEAL specified in the Technical Specification include: supporting applications from one or more verticals, offering SEAL services as APIs to vertical applications, supporting notification mechanisms, and ensuring the API interactions between the vertical application server(s) and SEAL server(s) will conform to CAPIF.

documents.title: Purpose of the limits on spurious emissions in the document, and when do they become mandatory
documents.text: The limits on spurious emissions in the document are used for the protection of systems operating in frequency ranges other than the BS downlink operating band. They become mandatory when set by local or regional regulation for an operating band or specific systems.

documents.title: The role of the Information Model in the Network Resource Model (NRM)
documents.text: The Information Model in the Network Resource Model (NRM) defines the semantics and behavior of information object class attributes and relations in a protocol and technology neutral way.

documents.title: The responsibility of the NSP OSS SML in this possible solution
documents.text: The NSP OSS SML receives the service order request from the NSP BSS, analyzes the NSC requirements for network slice management capabilities exposure, captures them in the form of NSC-specific access control data, and sends a service order response to the BSS.

documents.title: Each deliveryMethod instance in an instance of the userServiceDescription element must refer
documents.text: Each deliveryMethod instance in an instance of the userServiceDescription element must refer to one Session Description fragment.

documents.title: The Packet Data Summary Report shall not be sent
documents.text: 3GPP TS 32.423 specifies that the Packet Data Summary Report shall not be sent.

documents.title: The 3GPP Technical Specification defines the requirements for handling USSD at the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 22.090 specifies that the 3GPP Technical Specification defines the requirements for handling USSD at the MS and network entities. It does not include specification of particular applications, nor does it specify how a particular application is selected.

documents.title: The guidelines for constructing the profile schema in 3GPP GUP
documents.text: The guidelines emphasize on modularity, extensibility, readability, easy support for versioning, and isolation of the schema components.

documents.title: Purpose of "Index of selected SCCPCH" in 3GPP TS 25.321
documents.text: The "Index of selected SCCPCH" identifies the selected SCCPCH with the PCH and the uniquely associated PICH to be used by the UE in 3GPP TS 25.321. It is selected based on "Initial UE Identity" as follows: "Index of selected SCCPCH" = "Initial UE Identity" mod K.

documents.title: Purpose of the detailed improvement analysis stage in the NM centralized SON function like CCO
documents.text: The purpose of the detailed improvement analysis stage is to do a more fine-grained assessment of the improvement possibility and its localization, which is done by using a fine-grained detection function/tool such as MDT with periodic measurements.

documents.title: The definition of sensitivity RoAoA in the context of satellite communication
documents.text: Sensitivity RoAoA is the sensitivity Region of Arbitrary Angle of Arrival (RoAoA) within the OTA sensitivity directions declaration. It is the region within which the declared EIS(s) of an OSDD is intended to be achieved at any instance of time for a specific SAN direction setting.

documents.title: One of the potential new requirements for 5G system to support secure clock signals to devices and application servers in a reliable manner
documents.text: The 5G system shall support a mechanism to verify authorization of a 3rd party application server to use a 5G timing resiliency service is one of the potential new requirements for 5G system to support secure clock signals to devices and application servers in a reliable manner.

documents.title: The meaning of "5G ProSe Direct Discovery" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications
documents.text: In 3GPP technical specifications, "5G ProSe Direct Discovery" refers to a function employed by a 5G ProSe-enabled UE to discover other 5G ProSe-enabled UEs in its vicinity based on direct radio transmissions between the two UEs with NR technology.

documents.title: The difference between the first digit's values in the version number of the 3GPP documents
documents.text: The first digit's value represents the stage of the document in the 3GPP standardization process. A version number with 'x' as the first digit is presented to the TSG for information, 'y' as the first digit is presented to the TSG for approval, and 'z' as the first digit is a TSG approved document under change control.

documents.title: Purpose of Concurrent Features Activation with Bi-control (CFA-BC) in B-ISDN
documents.text: CFA-BC enables a call to be influenced by some features at two different points concurrently, with a pre-defined set of features controlled by its context with bi-control relationship.

documents.title: Purpose of aligning channel model clusters with probe locations in an optimized chamber design
documents.text: The purpose of aligning channel model clusters with probe locations in an optimized chamber design is to emulate clusters from arbitrary angles if desired and to obtain a more precise Angle Spread for test signals.

documents.title: The MC service server's role when switching from MBMS delivery to unicast delivery
documents.text: The MC service server decides to send the downlink data by unicast delivery instead of MBMS delivery to the MC service client when the MC application detects bad MBMS bearer condition through the MC MBMS API.

documents.title: The priority order for cell reselection when multiple RAT/frequency cells fulfill the cell reselection criteria
documents.text: Cell reselection to a higher priority RAT/frequency shall take precedence over a lower priority RAT/frequency if multiple cells of different priorities fulfill the cell reselection criteria.

documents.title: The eKSI of the EPS security context to be modified and a
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that the eKSI of the EPS security context to be modified and a new set of selected NAS security algorithms.

documents.title: The default priority assigned to a location service request if the LCS Priority parameter is absent in a BSSMAP-LE Perform Location request
documents.text: If the LCS Priority parameter is absent in a BSSMAP-LE Perform Location request, the lowest priority shall be assumed.

documents.title: Purpose of the Hosted SEPP providers using their own unique credentials for authentication
documents.text: The Hosted SEPP providers must use their own unique credentials for authentication to enable operators that receive signaling from a Hosted SEPP provider to verify that the Hosted SEPP provider has been authorized by the roaming partner. This helps to ensure the security and integrity of communication between different PLMNs.

documents.title: The focus of the enhanced FR2 HST requirements in 3GPP TS 38.854 v0.4.0
documents.text: The enhanced FR2 HST requirements in 3GPP TS 38.854 v0.4.0 focus on cell re-selection, RRC connection mobility control, gradual timing adjustment, SSB based radio link monitoring and beam failure detection, intra-frequency measurement, and L1-RSRP/SINR measurement for specific scenarios. Additionally, it specifies the new requirements of one shot large UL timing adjustment and TCI state switch delay for FR2 HST scenarios.

documents.title: Purpose of the test procedure outlined in 9.3.1C.4.2
documents.text: The purpose of the test procedure outlined in 9.3.1C.4.2 is to verify that the reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator (CQI) under AWGN (additive white Gaussian noise) propagation conditions with periodically varying radio conditions is within the specified limits.

documents.title: Method supports the creation of an Individual Application Session Context
documents.text: The POST method in 5.3.2.3.1 supports the creation of an Individual Application Session Context.

documents.title: The four requirements specified for the flexible layer one in the context of IMS services
documents.text: The four requirements specified for the flexible layer one in the context of IMS services are: (1) to fulfill most of the IMS requirements in terms of radio bearer service attributes, (2) to support the multiplexing of parallel flows onto a basic physical subchannel, (3) to provide an optimisation of spectral efficiency through the support of different interleaving depths, unequal error protection/detection, reduced channel coding rate granularity, and support of 8PSK and GMSK modulations, and (4) to provide an efficient support of real-time IMS services.

documents.title: The receiving side should discard the received AMD PDU
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.322 specifies that the receiving side should discard the received AMD PDU.

documents.title: Any PLMN code that is already in the "forbidden PLMN list" shall
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that any PLMN code that is already in the "forbidden PLMN list" shall be removed from the "equivalent PLMNs" list before it is stored by the mobile station.

documents.title: Purpose of the IMS Voice Over PS Sessions Support Indicator
documents.text: The IMS Voice Over PS Sessions Support Indicator indicates whether IMS Voice Over PS Sessions is supported at the UE's current routing area.

documents.title: If all automatic attempts fail, the user shall be informed and the
documents.text: If all automatic attempts fail, the user shall be informed and the failed message should be stored in the mobile in such a way that the user can request a retransmission using the same TP-MR value, without the need to re-enter any information.

documents.title: Purpose of the propagation condition "Case 2" in the UTRA simulations
documents.text: The purpose of the propagation condition "Case 2" in the UTRA simulations is to test the receiver under high delay spread conditions, ensuring efficient support of repeaters and not exceeding reasonable complexity or performance impact on the receiver.

documents.title: Purpose of Common access class control in the network
documents.text: Common access class control allows the network to restrict access for certain groups of mobile stations, also known as access classes, for access to both domains or to one domain only.

documents.title: An Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects
documents.text: An IRP is a reference point that defines the interface between two functional entities in the 3GPP network, allowing them to interact and exchange information based on a common information model.

documents.title: The UE should insert the public GRUU value in the Contact header
documents.text: The UE should insert the public GRUU value in the Contact header field if a public GRUU value has been saved associated with the public user identity from the P-Called-Party-ID header field, and the UE does not indicate privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity.

documents.title: The MCPTT client should display an indication that this is an MCPTT
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.379 specifies that the MCPTT client should display an indication that this is an MCPTT emergency group call, the MCPTT ID of the originator, the MCPTT group identity, and if the <alert-ind> element is set to "true", an MCPTT emergency alert and associated information.

documents.title: The objective of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's LTE 450 MHz in Brazil work item
documents.text: The objective is to specify technical requirements for deploying LTE operation in the 450 MHz band in Brazil.

documents.title: It must be considered that if a UE does not support RAT
documents.text: It must be considered that if a UE does not support RAT 1, energy saving measures of RAT 2 may result in a loss of service for that UE.

documents.title: The media key can be retrieved from the KMS based on the
documents.text: The media key can be retrieved from the KMS based on the identities of calling parties. If the terminal is roaming, the KMS in the visited network or the home network can be contacted to retrieve the media key.

documents.title: It indicates that a number of ongoing call sessions have aborted or
documents.text: It indicates that a number of ongoing call sessions have aborted or terminated abnormally.

documents.title: Handover Optimization based on UE Load can benefit the target eNB by
documents.text: Handover Optimization based on UE Load can benefit the target eNB by providing knowledge about the projected UE load, including additional radio and virtual resources. This information can help the target eNB manage its resources more efficiently and handle handover requests more effectively, leading to improved network performance.

documents.title: The "DL total available PRB" measurement provides the total number of physical
documents.text: The "DL total available PRB" measurement provides the total number of physical resource blocks (PRBs) available for downlink transmission in 5G.

documents.title: The Node B shall activate the inner loop DL power control for
documents.text: The Node B shall activate the inner loop DL power control for all RLs, if the received Inner Loop DL PC Status IE is set to "Active" in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message.

documents.title: During the dialog, the UE should populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field in
documents.text: During the dialog, the UE should populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request or response within a dialog with the current point of attachment to the IP-CAN (e.g. the current cell information).

documents.title: The effect of the Implicit De-registration timer expiring before the UE contacts the network
documents.text: If the Implicit De-registration timer expires before the UE contacts the network, the AMF implicitly de-registers the UE.

documents.title: The difference between UUAA-MM and UUAA-SM in 5G System
documents.text: UUAA-MM is performed at 5GS registration based on operator's policy and it is used to authenticate and authorize a UAV when registering with 5GS. Whereas UUAA-SM is performed at PDU session establishment and it is used to re-authenticate the UAV or to reauthorize at PDU session modification or EPS bearer modification if the UE includes CAA-Level UAV ID and a UUAA Aviation Payload.

documents.title: The MCX Service shall be capable of requesting increased priority for all
documents.text: The MCX Service shall be capable of requesting increased priority for all Participants of an Imminent Peril group communication, maintain knowledge of the Affiliated MCX Service Group Member(s) that initiated the Imminent Peril group communication, and maintain an In-progress Imminent Peril condition from the time the initial Imminent Peril group communication was requested until the In-progress Imminent Peril condition is cancelled.

documents.title: The aim of the present document (Technical Report in 3GPP's 3rd Generation Partnership Project) in supporting maritime communication services
documents.text: The present document aims to support maritime communication services between users ashore and at sea or between vessels at sea over the 3GPP system, targeting improved maritime safety, protection of the maritime environment, and promotion of shipping efficiency. Ultimately, it aims to narrow the information gap between mobile users on land and shipboard users on vessels at sea by enabling mobile broadband services.

documents.title: Purpose of sending uplink power control commands to the UE
documents.text: The purpose is to ensure that the UE output power at each antenna connector measured by the test system is within the Uplink power control window.

documents.title: The role of the IRI-POI function in the 3GPP system
documents.text: The IRI-POI function is responsible for providing intercept capabilities in the 3GPP system.

documents.title: The TMSI status information element (9.4.1.3) is included in the ATTACH REQUEST
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that the TMSI status information element (9.4.1.3) is included in the ATTACH REQUEST message when the MS performs a combined GPRS attach and no valid TMSI is available.

documents.title: Purpose of hardening requirements in the described security problem definition
documents.text: Hardening requirements aim to reduce the attack surface and security vulnerability of the network product, ensuring that security functions cannot be bypassed and unneeded or insecure functionality is removed.

documents.title: The PGW-C shall delete all the Bearer contexts associated with the PDN
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.244 specifies that the PGW-C shall delete all the Bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection with a delete session message to SGW-C and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

documents.title: The potential security requirements related to "Security aspects of Data Channel usage in IMS network"
documents.text: The potential security requirements are: (1) communication over IMS data channel shall be confidentiality, integrity and replay protected, (2) the peers over IMS data channel shall be mutually authenticated, and (3) the path between IMS-AGW and external data server shall be confidentiality, integrity and replay protected.

documents.title: Purpose of the "Spare extension" field in the error handling procedure
documents.text: The "Spare extension" field is included in the error handling procedure to allow for the addition of new fields or information in later versions of the document, without being interpreted by the receiver in the current version of the document.

documents.title: When the UE changes into a new tracking area before receiving the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that when the UE changes into a new tracking area before receiving the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

documents.title: The format of the Operator Identifier based N3IWF FQDN
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.003 specifies that the format of the Operator Identifier based N3IWF FQDN is "n3iwf.5gc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org".

documents.title: The minimum requirements given in this specification make no allowance for measurement
documents.text: The minimum requirements given in this specification make no allowance for measurement uncertainty. The test specifications define test tolerances, which are used to relax the minimum requirements in this specification to create test requirements.

documents.title: The PCRF must provide all sdf templates which are part of active
documents.text: The PCRF must provide all sdf templates which are part of active PCC Rules to the TDF, with an indication of their precedence following the precedence of the corresponding PCC Rules they belong to. The TDF must then perform the comparison of the sdf templates and the detected application's traffic in the same order as received from the PCRF every time new IP flows belonging to the application are detected.

documents.title: In a successful Write-Replace procedure, the CN initiates the process by sending
documents.text: In a successful Write-Replace procedure, the CN initiates the process by sending a WRITE-REPLACE message to the RNC, which then broadcasts a new message or replaces an existing one as requested in the Service Areas List IE. The RNC uniquely identifies the CBS message using the Message Identifier IE and the leftmost bits of the Serial Number IE and Service Area Identifier IE.

documents.title: The range of values for the I bit in the ISDN access indicator
documents.text: The I bit in the ISDN access indicator can have a value of either 0 or 1, where 0 indicates an originating access non-ISDN and 1 indicates an originating access ISDN.

documents.title: The V2X Control Function's role in handling authorization for V2X communications over PC5 reference point
documents.text: The V2X Control Function in the HPLMN requests authorization information from the V2X Control Function of the serving PLMN, merges authorization information from home and serving PLMNs, and informs the UE of the final authorization information. It may revoke authorization at any time and notifies the V2X Control Function in the HPLMN when authorization is revoked by the VPLMN.

documents.title: The receiving entity should ignore that information element and treat the rest
documents.text: The receiving entity should ignore that information element and treat the rest of the message.

documents.title: The SMF shall reject the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure with an
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the SMF shall reject the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure with an appropriate 5GSM cause value in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.

documents.title: The role of the "source BSS" in the PS handover preparation phase
documents.text: The source BSS is responsible for requesting a PS handover for an MS with one or more PFCs subject to handover, and signalling radio resources and system information to the MS before it moves to the target cell. The source BSS also ensures that the target BSS/GANC reserves necessary resources for the active PFCs in the target network nodes.

documents.title: The role of "Adjusted Segment Availability Start Time" (ASAST) for a Segment
documents.text: ASAST is used to determine the exact availability time of a Segment for a Representation, which can be derived from the MPD using the Segment availability start time minus the Segment duration announced in the MPD. The ASAST is used to calculate the start time of each Segment within a Represention, considering any offsets provided in the MPD.

documents.title: The role of the Session Management Function (SMF) in the MBS service context
documents.text: The Session Management Function (SMF) may receive the UE's MBS context message from the AMF, classify UEs into different MBS service groups, and associate each group with a QoS profile.

documents.title: The UE sets the ue-Identity to the value received from upper layers
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that the UE sets the ue-Identity to the value received from upper layers.

documents.title: The ICS UE should include a "c=" line with the nettype portion
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.292 specifies that the ICS UE should include a "c=" line with the nettype portion set to "PSTN", a CS media "m=" line with the media portion set to "audio", and a=setup attribute set to "active". Additionally, it should add an a=cs-correlation attribute with the MSISDN of the ICS UE in the CS domain, in international E.164 number format.

documents.title: Intermodulation response rejection is a measure of the capability of a receiver
documents.text: Intermodulation response rejection is a measure of the capability of a receiver to receive a desired signal on the assigned channel frequency in the presence of two or more interfering signals that have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal.

documents.title: To indicate support of a specific CAMEL phase 4 CSI, a functional
documents.text: To indicate support of a specific CAMEL phase 4 CSI, a functional entity shall have the ability to trigger on any initial service event possible for that CSI. For example, if a functional entity supports the CAMEL phase 4 O-CSI, it shall indicate this in its registration request to the HLR.

documents.title: The GMK is used as the MIKEY Traffic Generating Key (TGK), and
documents.text: The GMK is used as the MIKEY Traffic Generating Key (TGK), and the GUK-ID is used as the MIKEY CSB ID. This results in a unique keystream for MCPTT Group communications. The keystream for MCPTT group communications differs across MCPTT groups, and where GUK-IDs differ, the SRTP Master Key and Master Salt will also differ. To identify the security context from the media stream, a SRTP/SRTCP Master Key Identifier (MKI) is required, which is a 64-bit value formed by concatenating the GMK-ID with the GUK-ID.

documents.title: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produces technical specifications for 3GPP (Third Generation
documents.text: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produces technical specifications for 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) systems, including UTRAN, E-UTRAN, and Iu mode GERAN.

documents.title: If upgrading the MCPTT group session to an MCPTT emergency call, the
documents.text: If upgrading the MCPTT group session to an MCPTT emergency call, the IWF performing the participating role shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in subclause~106.2.8.1.1 and a Resource-Priority header field, and comply with the procedures in subclause~106.2.8.1.2.

documents.title: The Content-Format value that should be set in the MSGin5G procedure for indicating application/json format in the CoAP payload
documents.text: The Content-Format value that should be set in the MSGin5G procedure for indicating application/json format in the CoAP payload is 50.

documents.title: The U-RNTI is only included as a MAC-c header to the MAC-d
documents.text: 3GPP TS 25.321 specifies that the U-RNTI is only included as a MAC-c header to the MAC-d PDU for DCCH (SRB#1) when using common H-RNTI in CELL_FACH state in FDD and 1.28 Mcps TDD.

documents.title: The role of the Broadcast Service Function (BSF) in the multi-modal QoS flow solution
documents.text: The BSF stores and updates the information of multi-modal data flows group, including the corresponding PCF IP address, UE IP address, etc. It also discovers other PCFs that are responsible for generating the QoS policy for multi-modal data flows belonging to the same multi-modal data flows group.

documents.title: If the participating MCVideo function cannot find a binding between the public
documents.text: If the participating MCVideo function cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCVideo ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired, then the participating MCVideo function shall reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with a specific warning text.

documents.title: The UE should include SIP URI(s) that contain the IP address of
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.229 specifies that the UE should include SIP URI(s) that contain the IP address of the UE or FQDN, the instance ID of the UE in the +sip.instance parameter if the UE supports GRUU, all supported ICSI values, and IARI values for the IMS communication services and IMS applications it intends to use in a sip.app-subtype feature tag.

documents.title: Purpose of providing Usage Monitoring control related information per access in the PDU Session related policy control information
documents.text: The purpose of providing Usage Monitoring control related information per access in the PDU Session related policy control information is to enable the PCF control of PDU Session level Usage Monitoring based on the access type used to carry the traffic.

documents.title: If the DPR MAC control element is included in Msg3 and the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.321 specifies that if the DPR MAC control element is included in Msg3 and the MAC PDU is successfully decoded, the MAC entity should provide the serving eNB with information about the amount of data available for transmission in the UL buffers associated with the MAC entity, and with information about the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmission power and the estimated transmission power for UL-SCH transmission for the Serving Cell. This information should be sent in the DPR MAC control element, which is placed before the CCCH MAC SDU in Msg3.

documents.title: A key issue with network-initiated activation and de-activation of functional alias(es)
documents.text: Currently, there are no procedures defined in 3GPP TS 23.280 or any other MC specification where the network initiates functional alias(es) activation/de-activation procedures.

documents.title: The focus of Solution 1, which proposes to use IPsec between the RN and DeNB to protect both the user plane and control plane signalling
documents.text: The focus of this solution is to prevent attacks by using IPsec to protect S1-AP/X2-AP interface between the RN and DeNB, and to use IPsec for both control plane and user plane to protect the S1-U and X2-U interfaces.

documents.title: FEC should be used to provide robustness against moderate packet loss rates
documents.text: FEC should be used to provide robustness against moderate packet loss rates at high delay scenario, especially in environments with high packet loss rates and/or high delay (RTT). However, it may not be appropriate when packet losses are caused by insufficient throughput since it introduces bit rate overhead.

documents.title: The IWF should send the Floor Request message toward the MCPTT floor
documents.text: The IWF should send the Floor Request message toward the MCPTT floor control server in the MCPTT system with the required Floor Priority and Floor Indicator fields, and the MCPTT ID associated with the requesting LMR user in a User ID field if privacy is not requested.

documents.title: The primary role of the 5GSM sublayer in 5GS session management
documents.text: The main function of the 5GSM sublayer in 5GS session management is to support the PDU session handling in the UE and in the SMF, which is transferred via the AMF.

documents.title: The old AMF determines whether the new AMF supports ATSSS based on
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.502 specifies that the old AMF determines whether the new AMF supports ATSSS based on the supported features provided by the new AMF during step 4 of the registration.

documents.title: The difference between a user channel and a control channel
documents.text: User channels are intended to carry user information, while control channels are used to provide signalling information for connection management, mobility management, and radio resource management.

documents.title: Purpose of the Missed ACK test in clause 10.2.2.2.1A.3
documents.text: The purpose of the Missed ACK test in clause 10.2.2.2.1A.3 is to verify that during an inter-cell soft handover for cell 1, the average probability for missed ACK, when E-HICH is transmitted using 12 consecutive slots, does not exceed specified values.

documents.title: Purpose of the dispatcher capabilities in the MCVideo service
documents.text: Dispatchers need advanced capabilities for managing MCVideo services for MCVideo Users and fixed cameras under their control, such as requesting a monitoring camera to transmit a video to the dispatcher, terminating the video transmission from the monitoring camera, and distributing a video to MCVideo Group Members.

documents.title: Specification defines the symbols and abbreviations used in the 3GPP TS 36.521-2 technical specification
documents.text: The definitions, symbols, and abbreviations in the 3GPP TS 36.521-2 technical specification are based on the terms and abbreviations given in TR 21.905, TR 36.509, TR 36.508, ISO/IEC 9646-1, and ISO/IEC 9646-7.

documents.title: The meaning of "methods" in the context of the OSA API
documents.text: In the context of the OSA API, "methods" refer to the functionalities supported by the service interface, which the implementation must support or implement.

documents.title: If the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport that contains measurement information concerning cells
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.331 specifies that if the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport that contains measurement information concerning cells other than the PCell, the UE should set the measResultIdleEUTRA and measResultIdleNR in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of measReportIdleEUTRA and measReportIdleNR in the VarMeasIdleReport.

documents.title: The aim of disabling unnecessary services on a network product
documents.text: The aim is to reduce the attack surface and risk of exploitation of any known security vulnerabilities.

documents.title: The relation between ARP and BCM in the context of EPS
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.203 specifies that the value of the ARP (Allocation and Retention Priority) of an EPS bearer is identical to the value of the ARP of the SDF(s) mapped to that EPS bearer, but SDFs associated with different QCIs or with the same service-level QCI but different ARP shall not be mapped to the same EPS bearer.

documents.title: The MME shall assume that the default set of EPS security algorithms
documents.text: 3GPP TS 33.401 specifies that the MME shall assume that the default set of EPS security algorithms is supported by the UE.

documents.title: Definition of the "Rule identifier"
documents.text: The "Rule identifier" is a unique value assigned to a PCC (Policy and Charging Control) rule within a PDU (Packet Data Unit) Session.

documents.title: Purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects' Performance Management (PM) specifications
documents.text: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects' Performance Management (PM) specifications is to define the concept, requirements, and performance measurements for the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's telecommunication network.

documents.title: The maximum number of intra frequency TDD cells that a UE is required to be able to monitor
documents.text: A UE is required to be able to monitor up to 32 intra frequency TDD cells (including serving cell).

documents.title: Purpose of the "Wait Time" between consecutive windows of time in the registration procedure
documents.text: The "Wait Time" is used to determine the start and end time of each consecutive window of time. It ensures that UEs only attempt registration during specific windows of time, allowing for a more staggered and manageable registration process.

documents.title: Purpose of locking down the virtualisation layer in a 3GPP network
documents.text: The purpose of locking down the virtualisation layer in a 3GPP network is to prevent unnecessary attack vectors, make it easier to monitor network behavior, and allow for maintenance and patching of the virtualisation layer and underlying hardware without impacting core services.

documents.title: The MCVideo client should set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request
documents.text: The MCVideo client should set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request to a public service identity of the participating MCVideo function serving the MCVideo user.

documents.title: The requirement for the IMS network and UE when communications do not use a communication service identifier
documents.text: The network and the terminal shall be able to support communications that do not use a communication service identifier. In the case that an IMS communication service identifier is not present, the network may assume a particular IMS communication service.

documents.title: Purpose of the "Promiscuous" approach in MBMS download
documents.text: Instructs FLUTE to receive all files available in the session.

documents.title: The UE should pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the UE should pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded because the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

documents.title: Reference point is used for the AAA-based charging solution in case of supporting the 3GPP offline charging system located in the HPLMN (non-roaming scenario) for fixed devices in the 3GPP and BBF network convergence architecture
documents.text: The Gza reference point is used for the AAA-based charging solution in case of supporting the 3GPP offline charging system located in the HPLMN (non-roaming scenario) for fixed devices in the 3GPP and BBF network convergence architecture.

documents.title: When no other Extension header follows, the value of the Next Extension
documents.text: When no other Extension header follows, the value of the Next Extension Header Type field is 0.

documents.title: Entities are affected by the new solution for NTN coverage analysis
documents.text: The NWDAF, AMF, and UE are affected by the new solution for NTN coverage analysis.

documents.title: The Mobile Station should not perform GPRS attach when in the same
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that the Mobile Station should not perform GPRS attach when in the same location area, delete the stored RAI, GPRS-CKSN, P-TMSI and P-TMSI signature, and store the LA in the 'forbidden location areas for regional provision of service'.

documents.title: One of the typical cause values for Radio Network Layer Causes
documents.text: One of the typical cause values for Radio Network Layer Causes is UL Radio Resources not Available.

documents.title: The mobile station should regard this as the network controlled cell reselection
documents.text: 3GPP TS 44.060 specifies that the mobile station should regard this as the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed and stop timer T3174. It shall then start timer T3176, return to the old cell, and send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to the network in the old cell.

documents.title: Purpose of an IOPS MC service group ID in the IOPS mode of operation
documents.text: An IOPS MC service group ID is used for identifying an MC service group in the IOPS mode of operation, and it allows the MC service UE to make communication with other member UEs within the same IOPS MC service group ID.

documents.title: Purpose of the silence descriptor (SID) frame in GSM mobile communications
documents.text: The SID frame conveys information on the acoustic background noise and initiates the comfort noise generation on the receive side.

documents.title: The advantage of adding new SDP attributes over solution D in terms of SDP processing load
documents.text: The new attribute appears only one time for each media line (and not potentially multiple times in the SDP offer) in the SDP answer, making the SDP processing load smaller compared to solution D.

documents.title: The POST request should contain N4 information related with traffic usage reporting
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.518 specifies that the POST request should contain N4 information related with traffic usage reporting (i.e. PFCP Session Report Request), and the DNAI related to the N4 information if the latter relates to a local PSA.

documents.title: A DASH client can determine if the highlight(s) is/are captured in the
documents.text: A DASH client can determine if the highlight(s) is/are captured in the Media Presentation, and if so, it can select Adaptation Sets that contain the highlight(s) without having to look into the Segments. A user or client is able to retrieve a full description of highlights independently from the MPD in order to minimize the size of the MPD.

documents.title: Purpose of the "ManifestUri" parameter in the e Media Streaming Services
documents.text: The "ManifestUri" parameter provides an HTTP URL where the Manifest for the Media Streaming Application Service is hosted and available for Media Clients access.

documents.title: The maturity status of current QUIC implementations, compared to TCP implementations
documents.text: Current QUIC implementations are not as mature as TCP implementations, as most of the features have been widely used and issues resolved in TCP, whereas QUIC is still new with a higher degree of issues expected due to mistakes and errors in implementation.

documents.title: The steps involved in the general procedure for uplink data transfer
documents.text: A mobile station in idle mode wishing to transfer data on the uplink follows a general procedure that involves synchronizing with the network, sending a channel request, monitoring the PDCCH for a response from the network, and transmitting data blocks on the assigned resources once a response is received.

documents.title: Purpose of a pseudonym indicator in the 5G location service
documents.text: The purpose of a pseudonym indicator in the 5G location service is to indicate that a pseudonym should be assigned by the network and transferred to the LCS Client as the UE's identity.

documents.title: Document provides a system-wide view of the operation of DRX in the GSM system
documents.text: The present document, 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in the GSM system (Release 17), provides a system-wide view of the operation of DRX in the GSM system.

documents.title: It indicates that the paging request from the network is set to
documents.text: It indicates that the paging request from the network is set to be rejected.

documents.title: The role of the SMF in providing updated ATSSS rules to the V-SMF
documents.text: The SMF (SMF-4G) provides updated ATSSS rules to the V-SMF (SMF-5G) as part of the N1 SM container in the PDU Session Modification Command, when the H-SMF has provided these rules.

documents.title: Optional feature is supported over S2a and S2b interfaces via GTPv2 control plane protocol for overload control in the context of eHRPD and TWAN or ePDG
documents.text: GTP-C Overload Control feature is the optional feature that is supported over S2a and S2b interfaces via GTPv2 control plane protocol for overload control in the context of eHRPD and TWAN or ePDG.

documents.title: The role of the HTTP proxy in a MCPTT network
documents.text: The HTTP proxy acts as a proxy for hypertext transactions between the HTTP client and one or more HTTP servers. It terminates a TLS session on HTTP-1 with the HTTP client of the MCPTT UE and allows the HTTP client to establish a single TLS session for hypertext transactions with multiple HTTP servers that are reachable by the HTTP proxy.

documents.title: GSMA OPG introduced the concept of Federation of Operator Platforms which allows
documents.text: GSMA OPG introduced the concept of Federation of Operator Platforms which allows Application Providers to reach a wider geographical area and user base.

documents.title: The AMF sends Enhanced Coverage Restricted information to the UE in the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the AMF sends Enhanced Coverage Restricted information to the UE in the Registration Accept message if the UE included support for restriction of use of Enhanced Coverage in step~1.

documents.title: The target UE can be addressed using MSISDN, SIP-URI, IP address, or
documents.text: The target UE can be addressed using MSISDN, SIP-URI, IP address, or a pseudonym based on IMSI or MSISDN.

documents.title: The base station output power requirements for LTE should be reused as
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.104 specifies that the base station output power requirements for LTE should be reused as the base station output power requirements for NB-IoT in both in-band and guard band operation.

documents.title: Purpose of the iE-Extensions field in the GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item
documents.text: The iE-Extensions field is used to include additional information as a ProtocolExtensionContainer in the form of GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item-ExtIEs.

documents.title: The purpose of this step is to update the list of MCVideo
documents.text: The purpose of this step is to update the list of MCVideo group information entries stored in the served MCVideo client information entry with the new set of candidate MCVideo group information entries received.

documents.title: Purpose of the UICC platform in the context of the 5G system
documents.text: The UICC platform, defined by ETSI SCP in TS 102 221, has been adopted by 3GPP to host the 3GPP applications, including the USIM and the ISIM, for many years. It remains a valid and appropriate solution to host 3GPP applications in a UE capable of registering on a 5G system.

documents.title: PDCP entity re-establishment during handover is supported for DRBs using RLC AM
documents.text: PDCP entity re-establishment during handover is supported for DRBs using RLC AM mode with a security key change, for DRBs using RLC AM mode with a data recovery procedure without a key change, for DRBs using RLC UM mode with a security key change, and for SRBs with a security key change or remaining as it is without a key change.

documents.title: The prerequisites for the solution where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party
documents.text: The two prerequisites for this solution are that the 3rd Party specific user identities and corresponding rich call data are associated with the corresponding IMS identities in a Database, and that the originating IMS network has a secure channel to the Database with Rich Call Data information.

documents.title: The significance of the MPD in DASH-enabled environments
documents.text: The MPD (Media Presentation Description) in DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) is significant as it sets up the live Media Presentation and provides crucial information such as availabilityStartTime, minimumUpdatePeriod, suggestedPresentationDelay, minBufferTime, timeShiftBufferDepth, and start times for the Period and SegmentTemplate in the Representation to enable access to media content closer to the live edge.

documents.title: The rules to prevent routing issues and complexity when performing group regrouping signalling using temporary groups on the MC system
documents.text: The IWF must prevent the regroup signalling from propagating to the LMR system, handle the translation between temporary group identities on the MC system and the original interworking group identity used on the LMR system, and ensure that regrouping can only take place within a system under specific conditions.

documents.title: The Load Prediction and Generation Prediction service helps Distribution System Operators (DSOs)
documents.text: The Load Prediction and Generation Prediction service helps Distribution System Operators (DSOs) in various ways. It forecasts the future values of power consumption and injection to give DSOs awareness of how grid operating conditions are expected to evolve. This enables DSOs to predict possible contingencies, apply preventive control schemes, and make informed decisions regarding planning and grid management.

documents.title: The major components involved in Multicast Distribution Setup procedure
documents.text: The major components involved in Multicast Distribution Setup procedure are MulticastDistributionSetupRequest, MulticastDistributionSetupResponse, and MulticastF1UContextDescriptor. The first two are used to initialize the setup process and the third one contains the necessary data to set up the multicast distribution.

documents.title: The format of the UECapabilityInfoIndication structure
documents.text: The UECapabilityInfoIndication structure is a SEQUENCE that contains a single field named protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container containing a set of UECapabilityInfoIndicationIEs.

documents.title: The symptoms of capacity and coverage optimization problems
documents.text: The symptoms of capacity and coverage optimization problems include coverage hole, weak coverage, pilot pollution, overshoot coverage, and DL and UL channel coverage mismatch.

documents.title: The MNO forms broadcast groups based on the number of UEs accessing
documents.text: The MNO forms broadcast groups based on the number of UEs accessing the same content, location information, content information, and association information among end-users, device information, and media content information.

documents.title: The difference between a root CA and a sub-CA in the context of network slicing
documents.text: A root CA is a top-level certificate authority, while a sub-CA is a certificate authority that operates under the root CA. Specific security requirements on network slices may require a dedicated root CA per slice to avoid potential security issues of "over trust.".

documents.title: The mechanism for reporting RAN user plane congestion information (RUCI) to the PCRF
documents.text: RUCI includes information such as UE IMSI, eNB identifier, APN for which congestion information is reported, and congestion level. It is reported to the PCRF by the RCAF to enable the PCRF to take RAN user plane congestion status into account for policy decisions.

documents.title: The disadvantage of the current mission critical core network architecture
documents.text: The current architecture exposes the mission critical core network to Mission Critical clients, requiring the client to know the SIP URI of each distinct MCX Server, and making intrusion detection within the XML signalling link impossible outside of the mission critical server.

documents.title: The S-CSCF will only shorten the expiry time for the <contact> sub-element
documents.text: The S-CSCF will only shorten the expiry time for the <contact> sub-element registered by the UE using its private user identity. It will not modify the expiry time for other <contact> elements associated with the same public user identity, if registered by another UE using different private user identities.

documents.title: Each xIRI message generated by the IRI-POI in IMS shall include the
documents.text: Each xIRI message generated by the IRI-POI in IMS shall include the target identity, additional identities associated with the target, time stamp, and correlation information.

documents.title: The difference between "ng-eNB-CU" and "ng-eNB-DU"
documents.text: Ng-eNB-CU is a logical node hosting RRC, SDAP, and PDCP protocols of the ng-eNB that controls the operation of one or more ng-eNB-DUs, while ng-eNB-DU is a logical node hosting RLC, MAC, and PHY layers of the ng-eNB, and its operation is partly controlled by ng-eNB-CU.

documents.title: The responsibility of the V2XCF when the eV2X service provisioning parameters need to be updated
documents.text: The V2XCF maintains the UE's current V2X Communication Parameters. The network can detect that the eV2X service provisioning parameters need to be updated due to the UE entering an Area of Interest or V2X AF/AS notifying updated parameter provisioning. In such cases, the V2XCF generates the updated eV2X Communication Parameters for the UE and delivers the updated eV2X Communication Parameters to UE via the AMF.

documents.title: The format of the Info-Package header field when the UE sends an INFO request containing an updated MSD
documents.text: The Info-Package header field is set to "EmergencyCallData.eCall.MSD" as defined in RFC~8147.

documents.title: The times represented in PolicyTimePeriodCondition can be interpreted as either local time
documents.text: The times represented in PolicyTimePeriodCondition can be interpreted as either local time or UTC time, depending on the value of the LocalOrUtcTime attribute.

documents.title: The uplink and downlink data transfer is suspended in the source SRNC
documents.text: The uplink and downlink data transfer is suspended in the source SRNC for RABs, which require delivery order during SRNS relocation.

documents.title: The USS must provide the 3GPP system with traffic filters and QoS
documents.text: The USS must provide the 3GPP system with traffic filters and QoS requirements during the establishment or modification procedure of the PDU Session/PDN connection for C2 communication.

documents.title: Only user-plane traffic (DTCH) is considered in these measurements
documents.text: Only user-plane traffic (DTCH) is considered in these measurements.

documents.title: The three options for the privacy verification of a value-added LCS client in the call/session unrelated class
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.271 specifies that the three options are positioning allowed without notifying the UE user, positioning allowed with notification to the UE user, and positioning requires notification and verification by the UE user (allowed only if granted by the UE user or if there is no response to the notification).

documents.title: A PolicyDomain and what are its nesting capabilities
documents.text: A PolicyDomain is a class that provides specialized rules per client application. It can nest other PolicyDomains, and there is no restriction on the depth of the nesting in sibling PolicyDomains.

documents.title: It contains enterprise operator related information such as the name, organization, address
documents.text: It contains enterprise operator related information such as the name, organization, address, phone, email, fax, payment method, etc.

documents.title: The name of the positioning procedure used by an LMF to support UE based and UE assisted positioning and delivery of assistance data
documents.text: The name of the positioning procedure used by an LMF to support UE based and UE assisted positioning and delivery of assistance data is The LPP protocol defined in TS~37.355.

documents.title: The general principle behind the hybrid ACELP/TCX core encoding algorithm
documents.text: The hybrid ACELP/TCX core encoding algorithm is based on deciding (in open-loop or closed-loop) which encoding model (ACELP or TCX) is best for encoding every block of input signal. ACELP is a time-domain, predictive encoder while TCX is a transform-based encoder. Different frame lengths are possible in TCX mode depending on the signal structure.

documents.title: In single stream region-independent coding, the content is encoded with the same
documents.text: In single stream region-independent coding, the content is encoded with the same resolution and quality settings over the complete 360 content and delivered as a single stream. The client decodes the complete stream but shows only the cropped part corresponding to the viewport.

documents.title: An option for the IWU when it receives a response to a SIP INVITE without an ALLOW header listing the UPDATE method from an external SIP-I network
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.163 specifies that the IWU can return the response to the preceding 3GPP node containing an ALLOW header listing the UPDATE method or consider the response received from the external network as erroneous and reject the call accordingly.

documents.title: MS operation modes A, B, and C are sometimes referred to as
documents.text: MS operation modes A, B, and C are sometimes referred to as GPRS class-A MS, GPRS class-B MS, and GPRS class-C MS respectively.

documents.title: Xlink
documents.text: Xlink:href.

documents.title: The meaning of CSG Indicator in a 3GPP system
documents.text: A CSG Indicator is an indication transmitted on the broadcast channel of the CSG cell that allows the UE to identify such a CSG cell.

documents.title: The procedure followed when a UE removes the Trusted WLAN access from a PDN connection under certain conditions
documents.text: The PDN GW indicates to the PCRF the removal of TWAN access for the multi-access PDN connection via IP-CAN Session Modification procedures, if dynamic PCC is applied for the PDN connection (step 4).

documents.title: The UDP destination port number for GTP-C request messages
documents.text: The UDP destination port number for GTP-C request messages is 2123.

documents.title: The maximum reporting range of RSRP in the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test
documents.text: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution in the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test.

documents.title: The definition of a narrowband in the context of 3GPP TS 36.211 clause 6.2.7
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.211 specifies that a narrowband is defined as six non-overlapping consecutive physical resource blocks in the frequency domain.

documents.title: The size of the buffer should identify the total amount of data
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.321 specifies that the size of the buffer should identify the total amount of data available across all logical channels of a logical channel group after the MAC PDU has been built. The amount of data is indicated in number of bytes and shall include all data that is available for transmission in the RLC layer and in the PDCP layer.

documents.title: At most one SCI can be valid for a PSSCH duration
documents.text: At most one SCI can be valid for a PSSCH duration.

documents.title: The difference between "Application Client" and "Application Server" in the context of the document
documents.text: "Application Client" refers to the client-side application software in the UE, while "Application Server" refers to the server-side application software in the cloud.

documents.title: The AF establishes a TLS (Transport Layer Security) session with the NEF
documents.text: The AF establishes a TLS (Transport Layer Security) session with the NEF to secure their communication.

documents.title: The significance of privacy protection mechanism in NWDAF
documents.text: Privacy protection mechanism in NWDAF is essential to prevent user data leakage and to ensure privacy-related information is processed before being utilized by NWDAF to output analysis results.

documents.title: The L3 filter used for in the test procedure
documents.text: The L3 filter is used to filter measuring values for RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR to meet the applicable requirements in clause~9 in 3GPP TS 36.133.

documents.title: The maximum RF output power reduction capability of the BSS from its maximum level, as defined in 3GPP TS 45.005
documents.text: 3GPP TS 45.005 specifies that the BSS shall be capable of reducing its RF output power from its maximum level by nominally 30 dB, in 15 steps of nominally 2 dB.

documents.title: The difference between Pull and Push methods of notification delivery in the MCData service
documents.text: In Pull method, the application shall use the provided channel endpoint to pull the notifications from the MCData notification server. However, in Push notification delivery, the MCData notification server asynchronously delivers the events received from the application server to the application through a PUSH Enabler server.

documents.title: Initially, V2V operation over PC5 should be assumed for a single operator
documents.text: Initially, V2V operation over PC5 should be assumed for a single operator on a single carrier.

documents.title: The difference between the first and second digits in the version number of this 3GPP technical specification
documents.text: The first digit indicates the status of the document within the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, including technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

documents.title: The main difference between alternative 1 and alternative 2 for forwarding user-plane data between the CP function and UP function
documents.text: In alternative 1, the user-plane packet is encapsulated in a control message and forwarded using the signalling connection between the CP and UP functions, while in alternative 2, the user-plane packet is encapsulated using a UP encapsulation format and forwarded outside of the signalling connection. Alternative 2 is preferred over alternative 1, especially in scenarios where the amount of user-plane traffic is considerable and control protocols are not designed to carry user-plane traffic.

documents.title: GBA modes can a UE indicate in the User-Agent header field for HTTP requests
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.109 specifies that a UE can indicate both AKA-based and GBA_Digest modes in the User-Agent header field, separated by multiple "product" tokens.

documents.title: The OIP service provides the terminating user with the possibility of receiving
documents.text: The OIP service provides the terminating user with the possibility of receiving trusted (i.e. network-provided) identity information in order to identify the originating user.

documents.title: The interface between Local V2X application servers should have confidentiality, integrity, and
documents.text: The interface between Local V2X application servers should have confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection implemented, along with mutual authentication between Local V2X application servers to ensure data security.

documents.title: Entity in the 5GC interact with the AF if it is in the untrusted domain
documents.text: If the AF is in the untrusted domain, it interacts with the NFs in 5GC via NEF.

documents.title: The spectrum emission mask for UTRA FDD UE defined relative to
documents.text: 3GPP TS 25.101 specifies that the RRC filtered mean power of the UE carrier.

documents.title: The home routed roaming procedure defined in clause~4.9.1.4 is applied, with V-SMF
documents.text: The home routed roaming procedure defined in clause~4.9.1.4 is applied, with V-SMF replaced by I-SMF.

documents.title: The UE must store the Service Gap Time value and apply Service
documents.text: The UE must store the Service Gap Time value and apply Service Gap Control as specified in TS~23.501 clause~5.31.16.

documents.title: The role of the MBS-Aware Application in deactivating the MBS User Service Session
documents.text: The MBS-Aware Application invokes a client API exposed by the MBSF~Client to deactivate the MBS User Service Session, which in turn deactivates the MBS Distribution Sessions and sends the Distribution Session deactivated event to the MBS Application Provider.

documents.title: The role of the GGSN in the bearer establishment for SIP signalling
documents.text: When the bearer establishment is controlled by the GPRS IP-CAN, the GGSN follows the procedures described in 3GPP TS 29.061 in order to establish a dedicated PDP context for SIP signalling.

documents.title: The difference between step 2a and step 2b of clause 5.6.3.1 in the procedure for reporting Monitoring Events by the MME/SGSN or HSS
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.336 specifies that step 2a describes the Monitoring Indication message sent by the MME/SGSN, while step 2b describes the Monitoring Indication message sent by the HSS. Step 2b also includes External ID or MSISDN if the indication is associated with an individual Group Member UE.

documents.title: RELEASE COMPLETE message
documents.text: RELEASE COMPLETE message.

documents.title: The UE should stop trying to acquire the particular SIB
documents.text: The UE should stop trying to acquire the particular SIB.

documents.title: The Slice-Specific Service Area information element includes TA(s) in the RA where
documents.text: The Slice-Specific Service Area information element includes TA(s) in the RA where the slice is available, based on which the UE may request the not allowed S-NSSAI again if it is in a TA of the RA where the slice is available i.e. based on Slice-Specific Service Area information.

documents.title: Purpose of the P-MIP signaling in the Proxy MIP solution
documents.text: The P-MIP signaling in the Proxy MIP solution is used to get a PDN IP address (Home Address) obtained at network attachment or based on explicit PDN IP address request from the UE, and data from UE are sent directly to the UPE using the Home Address as source address.

documents.title: The relationship between the CDF and the CGF in the 5G ProSe architecture for ProSe Function generating charging information with an integrated CDF
documents.text: If the ProSe Function generating the charging information has an integrated CDF, then the ProSe Function can produce CDRs. The CGF may also be integrated in the ProSe Function, or it may exist as a physically separate entity.

documents.title: The Back-off timer value IE is included in the PDU SESSION RELEASE
documents.text: The Back-off timer value IE is included in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message when the network requests a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.

documents.title: The significance of the Precedence field in a routing rule for the PCRF
documents.text: The Precedence field in a routing rule defines in what order the routing rules is used by the PCRF to determine where to route a service data flow. It is derived from the priority included in the Binding Update.

documents.title: All timestamps in PM files should follow the representations allowed by the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 32.432 specifies that all timestamps in PM files should follow the representations allowed by the ISO 8601 standard. The precise format for timestamp representation should be derived from ISO 8601. The representation should refer to either UTC time or local time or local time with an offset from UTC.

documents.title: The deployment of LPNs within the Macro area significantly increases the average
documents.text: The deployment of LPNs within the Macro area significantly increases the average and edge UE burst rates, and the gains amplify when the number of LPNs per Macro area and/or LPN transmit power increases.

documents.title: The default public user identity indicated by the HSS to the S-CSCF
documents.text: The default public user identity indicated by the HSS to the S-CSCF must be a registered public user identity.

documents.title: The eDRX-Related-RAT AVP indicates the RAT type to which the eDRX Cycle
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.274 specifies that the eDRX-Related-RAT AVP indicates the RAT type to which the eDRX Cycle Length is related in the 3GPP network.

documents.title: Purpose of discreet monitoring and audit of user content in the MC system
documents.text: Discreet monitoring and audit allow access to user voice, video, and data communications for public safety authorities. They are required functions in a public-safety network and are performed in real-time for monitoring, or at some point after recording for audit purposes.

documents.title: The minimum performance requirements that are applicable to both SA and NSA, as defined in Clauses 5-8, except for Clauses 9 and 10
documents.text: All minimum performance requirements defined in Clauses 5-8 are applicable to both SA and NSA, unless explicitly stated otherwise in Clauses 9 and 10.

documents.title: The individual Unicast PC5 DRXs are determined based on all the ongoing
documents.text: The individual Unicast PC5 DRXs are determined based on all the ongoing traffic of the UE's Unicast Links, other than just the traffic of this current Unicast Link. Consequently, the individual Unicast PC5 DRX of each UE can be different.

documents.title: The rule for setting the physical cell identity of Cell 2 for next iteration of the test procedure loop
documents.text: Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

documents.title: The role of the CBE and its interface with the CBC in CBS
documents.text: The CBE (Cell Broadcast Entity) connected to the Cell Broadcast Centre, is responsible for providing CBS messages, while CBC is responsible for sending these messages to the cells. The interface between CBE and CBC is however out of the scope of 3GPP specifications.

documents.title: Used to encode DTMF events in an IMS network
documents.text: The IETF RFC 4733 is used to encode DTMF events in an IMS network.

documents.title: Purpose of the Uplink power control window in the context of the test requirements specified in the document
documents.text: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no greater than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

documents.title: The operational testing feature in 5G networks designed to do
documents.text: The operational testing feature in 5G networks is designed to assist in testing upgraded network nodes in the operational network, increasing the agility of 5G networks. This is achieved through slicing and virtualization, allowing for the creation of a test network slice instance or test NF for testing purposes.

documents.title: IABTNLAddressesRequested represents the request for IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) or prefixes
documents.text: IABTNLAddressesRequested represents the request for IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) or prefixes.

documents.title: The role of the NAF in this process
documents.text: The NAF initiates the UE authentication, validates the response digest, and retrieves the shared application specific NAF key to validate the assertion received from the OpenID Provider.

documents.title: The responsibility of the non-controlling MCData function when a SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response is received
documents.text: The non-controlling MCData function shall forward the SIP response to the originating participating MCData function and take no further action.

documents.title: The significance of the notation 'Mandatory' when discussing SIP extensions in the context of the NGCN-NGN interface
documents.text: The notation 'Mandatory' refers to SIP extensions that the NGCN is required to support for the NGCN-NGN interface.

documents.title: Security for PMIP messages between MAG and LMA can be provided either
documents.text: Security for PMIP messages between MAG and LMA can be provided either by a chain of security associations in a hop-by-hop fashion or by one security association per direction in an end-to-end fashion. Confidentiality protection is optional. TS 33.210 and TS 33.310 are used to secure PMIP messages in the reference points S2a, S2b, S5, and S8.

documents.title: The VAE-S must send a HTTP POST request message to each VAE-C
documents.text: The VAE-S must send a HTTP POST request message to each VAE-C associated with the target geographical area.

documents.title: The MS should perform the handover, use the commanded mode and/or algorithm
documents.text: The MS should perform the handover, use the commanded mode and/or algorithm on the new channel, and not change the ciphering key.

documents.title: Open Service Access (OSA) in the context of 3GPP
documents.text: Open Service Access (OSA) is a framework in 3GPP that allows application developers to access network functionality through a standardized open interface, i.e. the OSA APIs, enabling them to build innovative applications that can utilize the capabilities of the underlying network infrastructure.

documents.title: The mobile station should enter DTR mode and start monitoring only the
documents.text: The mobile station should enter DTR mode and start monitoring only the indicated PDCH or PDCH-pair (and if applicable, carrier) within the reaction time specified in 3GPP TS 45.010.

documents.title: A software application that integrates audio-visual content into the user's real-world environment in AR devices
documents.text: The software application that integrates audio-visual content into the user's real-world environment is AR/MR Application.

documents.title: The user equipment measures the timing deviation by subtracting the reference time
documents.text: The user equipment measures the timing deviation by subtracting the reference time Tref from the time at which the first path of the UpPCH is received.

documents.title: After receiving a positive response from the AF, the SMF establishes a
documents.text: After receiving a positive response from the AF, the SMF establishes a temporary N9 forwarding tunnel and keeps the current Source BP/ULCL and Source UPF (PSA2) for some time, allowing the UE traffic to continue reaching the old EAS.

documents.title: Purpose of associating a specific V-EASDF address with a specific HPLMN ID, S-NSSAI, and DNN
documents.text: This association allows the V-EASDF to support DNS contexts with the same (private) UE IP address from different PLMNs, S-NSSAI, and DNNs, and identify the DNS context matching an incoming DNS request.

documents.title: The transmission participant should send a Transmission end request message towards the
documents.text: The transmission participant should send a Transmission end request message towards the transmission control server, start timer T101 (Transmission End Request), initialize counter C101 (Transmission End Request) to 1, and enter the 'U: pending end of transmission' state.

documents.title: Create Session Request message
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.401 specifies that create Session Request message.

documents.title: The definition of "personal data" in the document
documents.text: Personal data is defined as information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person; an identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identity such as a name, an identification, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person.

documents.title: The time duration that starts the BWP switching process on all serving cells for a UE
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.213 specifies that the time duration TMultipleBWPswitchDelay starts from the beginning of DL slot n, where slot n is the earliest DL slot where a BWP switching request is received among all serving cells on which the UE is performing simultaneous DCI-based BWP switching.

documents.title: When a recipient detects this event, it should ignore the information that
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.007 specifies that when a recipient detects this event, it should ignore the information that it is unable to understand and treat the message based on the information that remains.

documents.title: The IRPManager must prepare the value of the attribute criterion and attribute
documents.text: 3GPP TS 32.622 specifies that the IRPManager must prepare the value of the attribute criterion and attribute userLabel of the to-be-created HNBProfile, and then use either Basic CM IRP IS createMO or Bulk CM IRP IS BulkCmCreateMo (Create MO Sub-operation) to create the HNBProfile instance.

documents.title: The transmission participant should send a Transmission end request message towards the
documents.text: The transmission participant should send a Transmission end request message towards the transmission control server, start timer T101, and enter the 'U: pending end of transmission' state.

documents.title: The basic requirements for streaming in 3GPP networks
