documents.text: The streaming service uses a client / server model which is transparent to the PLMN, utilizes existing standards (codecs and protocols) where these are available, and utilizes the PS Domain with QoS requirements as specified in 3GPP TS 22.105.

documents.title: If the I-MGCF has received a P-Early-Media header field in the initial
documents.text: If the I-MGCF has received a P-Early-Media header field in the initial INVITE request and has not already sent a provisional response including the P-Early-Media header field with parameters indicating that a backward early media is not authorized, then it shall send the 183 Session Progress response with the P-Early-Media header field indicating the backward early media is not authorized.

documents.title: The role of the ProSe layer in the Discovery Complete message in the context of PC5 group communication
documents.text: The ProSe layer of each member UE passes groupcast related information/parameters such as Layer-2 ID information (i.e. source Layer-2 ID and destination Layer-2 ID), QoS related information, HARQ operation related information to the AS layer.

documents.title: Purpose of a TEID in the context of GTP tunnels
documents.text: A TEID (Tunnel Endpoint Identifier) unambiguously identifies a tunnel endpoint in the scope of a path, and each GTP tunnel is identified with a TEID, an IP address, and a UDP port number.

documents.title: The BPCF provides the fixed access with the S9a session and tunnel
documents.text: The BPCF provides the fixed access with the S9a session and tunnel information used by a 3GPP UE or H(e)NB device. This allows the fixed access to associate the aggregate IP traffic plane with the S9a session towards the PCRF.

documents.title: The eNodeB shall indicate this in the list of rejected EPS bearers
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.413 specifies that the eNodeB shall indicate this in the list of rejected EPS bearers in the S1-AP UE Context Resume Request message.

documents.title: In NRTC1 transmitter tests, as many carriers as the Base Station supports
documents.text: In NRTC1 transmitter tests, as many carriers as the Base Station supports within an operating band and fit in the rest of the declared maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth are selected and placed adjacent to each other starting from the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge.

documents.title: The function of UTC-based counter in ProSe Public Safety Discovery
documents.text: The UTC-based counter provides freshness for the protection of the restricted discovery message on the PC5 interface and helps protect against replays.

documents.title: The HSS reads STN-SR and UE SRVCC Capability data from the EPS-UDR
documents.text: The HSS reads STN-SR and UE SRVCC Capability data from the EPS-UDR or the 5GS-UDR in the SRVCC procedure.

documents.title: The UE considers the USIM as invalid for EPS services and non-EPS
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that the UE considers the USIM as invalid for EPS services and non-EPS services and enters state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

documents.title: The "L" in the length indicator indicates the number of octets contained
documents.text: The "L" in the length indicator indicates the number of octets contained in the information field of UI, SABM, UA or I frames.

documents.title: The UE should acknowledge the reception of the "UE application trigger request"
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.682 specifies that the UE should acknowledge the reception of the "UE application trigger request" notification via NAS signalling to the MME/SGSN, check for duplicates, establish the relevant PDN connection if it is not already established, and trigger the UE application which then contacts the network application server in the network.

documents.title: The action taken by the User Equipment after receiving a SERVICE REJECT message with the cause "Roaming not allowed in this location area" from the network
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that the User Equipment shall set the PS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, store the LAI in the list of "forbidden location areas for roaming" and perform a PLMN selection.

documents.title: The significance of shared key material between UE and the mobile operator's PKI portal
documents.text: UE and the mobile operator's PKI portal must share key material for the certificate request and operator CA certificate retrieval to be protected. This requirement ensures secure communication between the UE and the mobile operator's PKI portal.

documents.title: The significance of version numbering x.y.z in the NBAP document
documents.text: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of the document (presented for information, presented for approval, or approved under change control). The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated.

documents.title: The role of the Charging Gateway Function (CGF) in the charging process
documents.text: The Charging Gateway Function receives CDRs produced by the CDF immediately via the Ga reference point and acts as a gateway between the 3GPP network and the Billing Domain.

documents.title: LTE interface is concluded to be feasible for supporting V2P services
documents.text: It is concluded that V2P services can be supported over both Uu and PC5 interfaces.

documents.title: The initiating UE creates a PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.304 specifies that the initiating UE creates a PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.

documents.title: When the QoS monitoring reports are sent by the SMF bypassing the
documents.text: When the QoS monitoring reports are sent by the SMF bypassing the PCF, the SMF updates the PCC rule with the "refQosMon" attribute referring to a QosMonitoringData instance which does not include the "directNotifInd" attribute set to true and still includes the "notifyUri", and the "notifyCorreId" attributes.

documents.title: Purpose of a functional alias in the MCX Service system
documents.text: A functional alias is a structured combination of organizationally meaningful elements that can be associated to MCX Users for the purpose of routing location-dependent communications. The functional alias can be structured as a combination of user, agency, organization, country, role, mission, function, equipment ID, label, first name, and family name.

documents.title: The consequence of a lower layer failure happening on the new channel before the ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message is sent
documents.text: In such a situation, the MS deactivates the new channels, reactivates the old channels, reconnects the TCHs, triggers the establishment of the main signalling link and sends a ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message, cause "protocol error unspecified" on the main DCCH before it resumes the normal operation, as if no assignment attempt had occurred.

documents.title: The name of the request message that the 3GPP AAA server sends to the CDF when the WLAN UE establishes a WLAN session
documents.text: The name of the request message that the 3GPP AAA server sends to the CDF is Charging Data Start Request.

documents.title: The terminating AS shall deliver the available data to the terminating UE
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.607 specifies that the terminating AS shall deliver the available data to the terminating UE in Call-Info header fields, and shall not deliver the string "unavailable" for the missing elements.

documents.title: Some potential benefits of deploying wireless medical equipment in operating rooms for hospitals and healthcare providers
documents.text: Some potential benefits of deploying wireless medical equipment in operating rooms include equipment sharing for efficient resource optimization, on-demand addition of complementary imaging equipment during surgeries, suppression of hazardous cables, and improved infection control by reducing the number of medical devices and cables. In summary, going wireless in operating rooms can make procedures planning easier for hospitals and help improve the quality of care provided to patients by healthcare providers.

documents.title: The SMF performs UPF selection based on the information provided in the
documents.text: The SMF performs UPF selection based on the information provided in the PDU session establishment request from UE1. This information includes the destination address of UE2 and, optionally, a port-pair suggestion of UE2-DS-TT.

documents.title: Purpose of the XnAP IAB Resource Coordination procedure introduced in Rel-17
documents.text: The purpose of the XnAP IAB Resource Coordination procedure introduced in Rel-17 is to allow source and target IAB-donors to coordinate the use of radio resources used on parent and child links.

documents.title: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected and store
documents.text: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected and store the following radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report by setting its fields as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.3.11.3.

documents.title: User plane ciphering at IP level protects the initial assigned IP-address from
documents.text: User plane ciphering at IP level protects the initial assigned IP-address from being disclosed, which helps prevent passive attackers from linking reallocated TMSIs with static IP-addresses.

documents.title: The UE should discard the PDCP SDU along with the corresponding PDCP
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.323 specifies that the UE should discard the PDCP SDU along with the corresponding PDCP PDU. If the corresponding PDCP PDU has already been submitted to lower layers, the discard is indicated to lower layers.

documents.title: The expected sequence for the specific message contents when the MS requests additional assistance data that is available in the SS
documents.text: The sequence is as follows: RRLP Positioning Capability Request -> RRLP Positioning Capability Response -> RRLP Assistance Data -> RRLP Measure Position Request -> RRLP Measure Position Response.

documents.title: The "UnMapGroupFromSessionStream" message is sent to indicate the de-association of the group
documents.text: The "UnMapGroupFromSessionStream" message is sent to indicate the de-association of the group call from the MBS session stream.

documents.title: The expected time limit for making the Minimum Set of Data (MSD) available to the PSAP in eCall
documents.text: The MSD should typically be made available to the PSAP within 4 seconds, measured from the time when the end-to-end connection with the PSAP is established.

documents.title: UE category does the test 9.2.5A.2 apply to
documents.text: This test applies to E-UTRA TDD UE Category 1bis release 13 and forward that support inter-frequency RSTD measurements.

documents.title: Purpose of the "SNRM-C" (SEAL Network Resource Management Client) in the document
documents.text: The SNRM-C (SEAL Network Resource Management Client) acts as the application client for network resource management related transactions.

documents.title: The controller UE should consider the transfer operation failed and continue the
documents.text: The controller UE should consider the transfer operation failed and continue the existing session with media components prior to the failed transfer attempt.

documents.title: Purpose of the PduSessionCreateData type name
documents.text: The purpose of the PduSessionCreateData type name is It provides session create information for SMF.

documents.title: The unit used for the measurement of mean virtual CPU usage for
documents.text: The unit used for the measurement of mean virtual CPU usage for a virtualized 3GPP NF is %.

documents.title: T312 should be started for the corresponding SpCell if T310 for the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.331 specifies that t312 should be started for the corresponding SpCell if T310 for the SpCell is running, and T312 is not running for the SpCell during the measurement reporting procedure.

documents.title: START DTMF ACKNOWLEDGE message
documents.text: START DTMF ACKNOWLEDGE message.

documents.title: The IP address received in the F-SEID allocated by the peer function
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.244 specifies that the IP address received in the F-SEID allocated by the peer function should be used to send PFCP session related messages for sessions that are already established.

documents.title: If required by local policy, the AS should log the request
documents.text: If required by local policy, the AS should log the request; if the AS receives any response to this request, it should also log the response.

documents.title: Purpose of recording the use of call forwarding
documents.text: Recording the use of call forwarding allows the Billing Domain (BD) to specify the supplementary service actions (invocation, registration, etc.) and determine how these events are to be recorded. Non-call related events are recorded as supplementary service action records, while call related events are recorded in-line in the appropriate CDR and/or in a separate SS-action record.

documents.title: The intended audience for the ISIM API specification
documents.text: The ISIM API specification is intended for network operators, service providers, server-ISIM, and database manufacturers.

documents.title: When the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity receives a positive
documents.text: When the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity receives a positive acknowledgement for an AMD PDU with SN = VT(A), it sets VT(A) equal to the SN of the AMD PDU with the smallest SN, whose SN falls within the range VT(A) < SN < VT(S) and for which a positive acknowledgment has not been received yet. If positive acknowledgements have been received for all AMD PDUs associated with a transmitted RLC SDU, the transmitting side shall send an indication to the upper layers of successful delivery of the RLC SDU.

documents.title: The Serving GW requests both IPv6 network prefix and IPv4 address in
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.401 specifies that the Serving GW requests both IPv6 network prefix and IPv4 address in the Proxy Binding Update for handover attach using PMIP-based S5/S8 when the UE requested deferred IPv4 address allocation for this PDN connection. This allows the UE to renew the IPv4 address allocation using DHCPv4 after the default bearer establishment procedure is completed.

documents.title: Purpose of the Serving Cell Identifier parameter in the BSSMAP-LE ASSISTANCE INFORMATION REQUEST message
documents.text: This parameter identifies the serving cell of the target MS for which the SMLC is requesting assistance information.

documents.title: The UE must include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that the UE must include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicates that the IMEISV is requested.

documents.title: Purpose of the Operations Systems interoperability architecture in a 3GPP system
documents.text: The purpose is to enable interoperability between operations systems in a 3GPP system, allowing different organizations to share information and interoperate, which is critical for managing third generation systems.

documents.title: The role of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G System
documents.text: The Policy Control Function (PCF) supports a unified policy framework to govern network behavior and provides Access and Mobility Management related policies to the NF service consumer.

documents.title: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project
documents.text: A collaboration between multiple standards organizations to define specifications for 3GPP wireless communication.

documents.title: The role of the Transport Network Layer (TNL) in the UTRAN Iub interface user plane protocols
documents.text: The Transport Network Layer (TNL) is expected to provide delivery of Frame Protocol PDUs. In-sequence delivery is not required, but frequent out-of-sequence delivery may impact the performance and should be avoided.

documents.title: The SCMS-S shall respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response and skip
documents.text: The SCMS-S shall respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response and skip the rest of the steps.

documents.title: The checkResources() method in the IpConfCallControlManager interface is used to check for
documents.text: The checkResources() method in the IpConfCallControlManager interface is used to check for the availability of conference resources within a specified period, with the option to include a conference duration and number of participants. It returns the actual number of available resources, the actual start and actual duration for which these are available. When no match is found, it returns a best effort with available, start time, duration, and resources.

documents.title: The cardinality rule for application clients
documents.text: One or more application clients can exist per PIN client.

documents.title: The role of the timing advance procedure in EGPRS
documents.text: The timing advance procedure is used to derive the correct value for timing advance that the MS has to use for the uplink transmission of radio blocks in EGPRS.

documents.title: The action in the Originating Basic Call State Model when an exception condition is encountered
documents.text: Default handling of the exception condition is being provided, which includes general actions to ensure no resources remain inappropriately allocated, like sending an error information flow indicating that outstanding call handling instructions will not run to completion and making use of vendor-specific procedures to release resources within the (G)MSC.

documents.title: The Occurrence property being "OneOrMore" indicates that this node must appear at
documents.text: The Occurrence property being "OneOrMore" indicates that this node must appear at least once and can appear multiple times.

documents.title: The "cp
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.604 specifies that the "cp:identity" and "ocp:external-list" conditions shall be evaluated against the calling party identity, which shall be taken from the P-Asserted-Identity header field, and additionally may be taken from the From header field or the Referred-By header field.

documents.title: The network may clear the transaction by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message
documents.text: The network may clear the transaction by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message if it has returned a result to the MS in a FACILITY message but does not receive a new location request operation in a FACILITY message or a RELEASE COMPLETE message from the MS after a PLMN administered time period has elapsed.

documents.title: The mechanism by which an MCPTT user can make a one-to-many MCPTT transmission to other users that are members of MCPTT group(s) called
documents.text: The mechanism by which an MCPTT user can make a one-to-many MCPTT transmission to other users that are members of MCPTT group(s) called is Group call.

documents.title: The ME must check if the SIM supports the feature of clock
documents.text: The ME must check if the SIM supports the feature of clock signal stoppage and must wait for at least 1~860 clock cycles after receiving the last character of the response before switching off the clock.

documents.title: The requirement for the ME when it is in the outgoing call / U4 call delivered state and receives a CONNECT message containing AoCC information from the network, while not supporting AoCC
documents.text: The ME shall acknowledge the CONNECT message but ignore and not acknowledge the AoCC information sent within the CONNECT.

documents.title: The P-CSCF shall keep the set of security associations that was used
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.229 specifies that the P-CSCF shall keep the set of security associations that was used for the REGISTER request that initiated the re-authentication, keep the newly established set of security associations created during this authentication and use the set of security associations and associated contact address that was used to protect the REGISTER request that initiated the re-authentication for further requests sent towards the UE as appropriate.

documents.title: One con of having MRFP generate CLUE messages in IMS
documents.text: One con is that enhancements on the Mp interface are needed for MRFC and MRFP interaction to handle CLUE messages and complete the SIP/SDP negotiation based on them.

documents.title: A key factor in the architecture for efficiently supporting routing of user traffic in roaming scenarios
documents.text: A key factor in the architecture for efficiently supporting routing of user traffic in roaming scenarios is the ability to route traffic via the VPLMN (visited public land mobile network) or back to the HPLMN (home public land mobile network).

documents.title: The main benefits of using the edgePMU concept in distribution networks
documents.text: The main benefits include utilizing the scalability of cloud infrastructure, decreasing the specialization needed in the data acquisition device, simplifying the adoption and deployment of PMUs, providing flexible cloud solutions for different data use cases, and having great flexibility in the development of monitoring and automation functionalities. The increased computational power offered by 5G edge cloud enables more computationally challenging algorithms to be deployed.

documents.title: The role of the primary MC system in the migration service authorization process
documents.text: The primary MC system performs authorization checks and records the migrated MC system's address, as well as any temporary address allocated, when the MC service user successfully migrates to a partner MC system.

documents.title: The advantage of using a session layer security solution external to MBMS for securing Group Communications
documents.text: The advantage of using a session layer security solution external to MBMS is that it can be applied to both Unicast and Multicast traffic so the routing of traffic can change dynamically without impacting security. Additionally, it does not require the BM-SC to be considered as part of the security architecture for the communication, and may not require the creation of new security functionality or interfaces as part of GCSE.

documents.title: The main feature of Scenario 4 in the 3GPP - WLAN interworking scenarios
documents.text: The main feature of Scenario 4 is that it allows the services supported in Scenario 3 to survive a change of access between WLAN and 3GPP systems, with no need for the user/UE to re-establish the service. However, there may be a change in service quality as a consequence of the transition between systems due to the varying capabilities and characteristics of the access technologies and their associated networks.

documents.title: The difference between a User Identity and a User Identifier
documents.text: A User Identity represents a user in a specific context, while a User Identifier is a piece of information used to identify one specific User Identity in one or more systems.

documents.title: A requirement for protecting data and information in transfer, as per industry best practice
documents.text: The usage of cryptographically protected network protocols is required. The transmission of data with a need of protection shall use industry standard network protocols with sufficient security measures and industry accepted algorithms.

documents.title: New elements are defined in HTML5 to standardize content embedding on a web page
documents.text: HTML5 defines new elements such as Video, Audio, Canvas, Svg, and Source, which allow for standardized ways to embed various types of media content, like video and audio, on a web page without using plugins.

documents.title: A requirement for indirect network communication paths in 5G
documents.text: Support for establishing a connection between Remote UE and a UE-to-Network Relay to ensure connectivity to the network for the Remote UE and end-to-end requirements, including QoS (such as data rate, reliability, latency) and handling of PDU Session related attributes (e.g. S-NSSAI, DNN, PDU Session Type and SSC mode).

documents.title: The GAN Iu Mode Cell Description information element provides a minimum description
documents.text: The GAN Iu Mode Cell Description information element provides a minimum description of a GAN Iu mode cell, which can be used to identify the GAN Iu mode cell in order to perform handover from GERAN/UTRAN.

documents.title: The role of the SEAL NRM server when acting as a TSN AF for TSN integration
documents.text: When acting as a TSN AF for TSN integration, the SEAL NRM server interacts with the CNC via the NRM-S reference point using the IEEE 802.1Qcc management protocol, and sets up TSN flows across the 5GS virtual bridges.

documents.title: The difference in resource consumption between Local switch and N19-based or N6-based traffic forwarding methods
documents.text: Local switch consumes less network resources compared to N19-based and N6-based traffic forwarding methods.

documents.title: Purpose of the present document in the context of the 3GPP GERAN NRM IRP
documents.text: The present document specifies the Solution Set definitions for the 3GPP GERAN NRM IRP, which is related to 3GPP TS 28.655 V14.0.X.

documents.title: The use of the OAuth 2.0 based authorization framework for the long-term key in the UDR
documents.text: The OAuth 2.0 based authorization framework is used to protect the long-term key from retrieval by unauthorized NFs and restrict modification to the sequenceNumber attribute.

documents.title: The MCPTT server shall identify the IMS public user identity from the
documents.text: The MCPTT server shall identify the IMS public user identity from the P-Asserted-Identity header field, perform the procedures in clause 7.3.1A, and check if the number of maximum simultaneous authorizations has been reached. If it exceeds the limit, the MCPTT server shall send a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response towards the MCPTT client with the warning text set to: "164 maximum number of service authorizations reached" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4.

documents.title: In this case, access identity 0 is applicable
documents.text: In this case, access identity 0 is applicable.

documents.title: Purpose of the 3GPP management system notifying about predicted threshold-crossing conditions in key issue #3
documents.text: The purpose is to support the DSO regarding the coordination of recovery actions, as the DSO needs to be notified in advance about pending threshold crossings.

documents.title: The mobile station shall send a CM SERVICE REQUEST to the network
documents.text: The mobile station shall send a CM SERVICE REQUEST to the network and proceed as in subclause 4.5.1.1.

documents.title: The main problem arising from an excessive delay in a speech channel
documents.text: The main problem arising from an excessive delay in a speech channel is the subjective effects of echo and simultaneous speech in both directions, which can negatively impact the user's communication experience.

documents.title: Upon receiving a RELEASE message for each call in the explicit call
documents.text: Upon receiving a RELEASE message for each call in the explicit call transfer invocation, successful case, second call alerting, the network sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message for each call, and the UE enters state U0 "Null". The call states are then verified by sending a STATUS ENQUIRY message in respect of the transaction identifier of each call, and receiving a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause #81 "invalid transaction identifier value".

documents.title: An ongoing session in the context of PS-CS access transfer
documents.text: An ongoing session is a session for which the SIP 2xx response for the initial SIP INVITE request to establish the session has been sent or received.

documents.title: Upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId, the UE
documents.text: Upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId, the UE shall initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

documents.title: The EES (ECSP-B) can determine to use ENS to discover the EAS
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.558 specifies that the EES (ECSP-B) can determine to use ENS to discover the EAS if the EES information of a partner ECSP is contained in the EAS discovery request and the required EAS is not available with the EES.

documents.title: The AMF shall send back to the UE the message which was
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the AMF shall send back to the UE the message which was not forwarded, send the 5GMM cause #22 "Congestion", and may include a back-off timer set to the remaining time of the timer T3447 as specified in subclause~5.4.5.3.1 case f.

documents.title: The NRPPa interface between pairs of gNBs/LMCs supports functions such as requesting
documents.text: The NRPPa interface between pairs of gNBs/LMCs supports functions such as requesting UL measurements, providing assistance data, changing DL PRS broadcast scheduling, and changing scheduling and resources for broadcast of location information.

documents.title: The function of the ng-eNB-CU-CP in NG-RAN
documents.text: The ng-eNB-CU-CP in NG-RAN hosts the RRC and the control plane part of the PDCP protocol of the ng-eNB-CU.

documents.title: The network and UE shall store the LLC SAPI and the radio
documents.text: The network and UE shall store the LLC SAPI and the radio priority in the PDP context for a system change to GSM.

documents.title: Priority Service assumes a signalling channel is always available when a Priority
documents.text: Priority Service assumes a signalling channel is always available when a Priority Service call encounters a "no radio available" condition in the call path involving an access or egress air-interface, or both.

documents.title: HTTP header should be used to identify the type and host name of the responding server when responding to an HTTP request
documents.text: The Server response header should be used to identify the type and host name of the responding server when responding to an HTTP request.

documents.title: The function of the MAC value calculated in step 1 of the authentication procedure
documents.text: The MAC value calculated in step 1 of the authentication procedure is used to ensure the integrity and authenticity of the SQN, Random, and capabilities indicator, which are sent in the registration request message.

documents.title: Upon receipt of the PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message, the UE shall check
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that upon receipt of the PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message, the UE shall check the PTI to identify the UE requested PDN connectivity, stop timer T3582 and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE. The UE should ensure that the PTI assigned to this procedure is not released immediately. The UE should wait for the Router Advertisement from the network with the IPv6 prefix information if it receives an IPv6 interface identifier in the PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message. If the UE accepts the PDN connection, it shall send a PDN CONNECTIVITY COMPLETE message and enter the state PDN CONNECTION ESTABLISHED.

documents.title: The VAL server performance analytics monitors parameters related to e.g
documents.text: The VAL server performance analytics monitors parameters related to e.g. VAL server number of connections for a given time and area, VAL server rate of connection requests, connection probability failure rates, RTT and deviations for a VAL server or VAL UE session, packet loss rates etc.

documents.title: The requesting controllee UE should include the Request-URI set to the SIP
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.237 specifies that the requesting controllee UE should include the Request-URI set to the SIP URI of the controller UE, the Referred-By header field containing a currently registered public user identity, and a Target-Dialog header field containing the dialog parameters for the dialog of the existing session.

documents.title: Some of the security challenges associated with sharing virtualized resources
documents.text: Some of the security challenges associated with sharing virtualized resources include the need to ensure that VNFs can be isolated from one another, particularly in the case where they have specific security requirements, and the potential risks of the noisy neighbour problem and side-channel attacks.

documents.title: The AMF should stop timer T3550 and change to the state 5GMM-REGISTERED
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the AMF should stop timer T3550 and change to the state 5GMM-REGISTERED. The 5G-GUTI, if sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, should be considered as valid.

documents.title: The PDU sessions are released locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.502 specifies that the PDU sessions are released locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the network.

documents.title: The old BSS may use the information to update the information about
documents.text: The old BSS may use the information to update the information about the load on the new cell, which may be used in the initiation of future cell load based handover procedures.

documents.title: The minimum requirement for the UE's reported CQI value in relation to the reported median CQI
documents.text: The reported CQI value should be within +/-2 of the reported median CQI more than 90% of the time.

documents.title: External entities are impacted when UE is connecting to 3GPP and Non-3GPP simultaneously
documents.text: The common impacted entities when UE is connecting to 3GPP and Non-3GPP simultaneously are LMF, AMF, N3IWF/TNGF, and UE.

documents.title: The format of the Tracking Area Identity based N3IWF FQDN using a 2-octet TAC
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.003 specifies that the format of the Tracking Area Identity based N3IWF FQDN using a 2-octet TAC is "tac-lb<TAC-low-byte>.tac-hb<TAC-high-byte>.tac.n3iwf.5gc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org".

documents.title: The minimum requirement for the OTA in-band selectivity for IAB-MT type 1-O and IAB-MT type 2-O
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.104 specifies that the minimum requirement for the OTA in-band selectivity for IAB-MT type 1-O is the same as for BS type 1-O in TS38.104, subclause 10.5.1.2. For IAB-MT type 2-O, the minimum requirement is the same as for BS type 2-O in TS38.104, subclause 10.5.1.3. The requirement applies at the RIB when the AoA of the incident wave of the received signal and the interfering signal are from the same direction and within the OTA REFSENS RoAoA, and the throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

documents.title: Purpose of testing unacknowledged data transfer without protection in the LLC procedures
documents.text: The purpose of testing unacknowledged data transfer without protection is to verify that the MS performs unacknowledged data transfer without protection in the correct manner, on SAPIs 5 and 9.

documents.title: The impact of the 3GPP PS Data Off feature on downlink traffic and 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services
documents.text: When the 3GPP PS Data Off feature is activated by the user, downlink traffic is prevented, except for 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services.

documents.title: A PDU session anchor, and what is its purpose
documents.text: A PDU session anchor is a functionality provided by a UPF (User Plane Function) to divert locally some traffic based on traffic filters. The purpose is to support traffic offloading or Single Session Continuity (SSC) mode 3, where a PDU session may have multiple N6 interfaces (to the same DN). The UL Classifier or IPv6 multi-homing at the UPF supports this anchor functionality, which provides forwarding of UL traffic towards different PDU session anchors and merges of DL traffic from different PDU session anchors to the UE.

documents.title: The Single-slot TCH loops used for in the MS
documents.text: The Single-slot TCH loops are used to establish transparent loops for TCH blocks with different error detection capabilities, providing access to isolated functions of the MS for type approval testing.

documents.title: The name of the request types that can be contained in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body for SIP INVITE requests for standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.582 specifies that the request types that can be contained in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body for SIP INVITE requests for standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function are "one-to-one-sds" and "group-sds".

documents.title: The system should display an indication that this is a SIP INVITE
documents.text: The system should display an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency group communication, the MCData ID of the originator, the MCData group identity with the emergency condition, and if the alert indicator is true, an indication of the emergency alert and associated information.

documents.title: The expected behavior of the NGCN site in terms of association during successful registration as per subclause 6.2.1.3
documents.text: Successful registration will result in an association between the NGCN site and the P-CSCF used for registration, based on mutual authentication between NGCN site and S-CSCF. The NGCN should be prepared to receive signalling traffic from the NGN over this association and in turn is expected to use this association when sending signalling messages to the NGN.

documents.title: In NR, a PDSCH assignment in a PDCCH conveys TB(s) to a
documents.text: In NR, a PDSCH assignment in a PDCCH conveys TB(s) to a certain UE, including time/frequency-domain resource information.

documents.title: P-CSCF#1 forwards the "reservation successful" message to UE#1 along the signalling path
documents.text: P-CSCF#1 forwards the "reservation successful" message to UE#1 along the signalling path established by the INVITE message.

documents.title: The main differences between Class A and Class B mobile stations in the context of mobile communications
documents.text: Class A and Class B are short forms for "class A mode of operation" and "class B mode of operation," respectively. Class A mobile stations can operate in circuit-switched (CS) and packet-switched (PS) domains simultaneously, while Class B mobile stations can only operate in CS or PS domains but not both at the same time.

documents.title: The UE should set the measResultNeighCells to include the best neighbouring cells
documents.text: The UE should set the measResultNeighCells to include the best neighbouring cells up to maxReportCells in accordance with the specified conditions, and include the physCellId for each cell that is included in the measResultNeighCells.

documents.title: The focus of the 3GPP Technical Report on UE power saving in NR for Release 16
documents.text: 3GPP TR 38.840 specifies that the focus of the report is to study the UE power saving framework in NR, taking into consideration of latency and performance as well as network impact. It includes the study of power saving schemes and procedures for UE adaptation to traffic and power consumption characteristics in different domains, as well as reduction of UE power consumption in RRM measurements.

documents.title: Some potential use cases for UICC access to IMS
documents.text: Some examples of use cases for UICC access to IMS include Over-The-Air remote management for single-user-multiple-UICC, Over-The-Internet UICC remote management, UICC-based Rich Communication Suite (RCS) Client, and User Authentication to Internet Services.

documents.title: UTRAN/GERAN (in Iu mode) should support TEID coordination, i.e
documents.text: UTRAN/GERAN (in Iu mode) should support TEID coordination, i.e. avoid using the same value ranges for its own unicast TEIDs as are used by the GGSN and MBMS GW for the Common TEID-Us (C-TEIDs).

documents.title: Purpose of the window duration represented by "/<X>/Speech/<X>/PLR/DURATION"
documents.text: The purpose of the window duration represented by "/<X>/Speech/<X>/PLR/DURATION" is to observe and compute the Packet Loss Rate (PLR) over this duration, and then compare the computed PLR with various thresholds.

documents.title: The MAC entity identifies the logical channel(s) for BRID or DAA based
documents.text: The MAC entity identifies the logical channel(s) for BRID or DAA based on the QoS information associated to BRID or DAA, i.e. PQI(s), from upper layers.

documents.title: The two modes of the MCID service as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification
documents.text: 3GPP TS 22.081 specifies that the two modes of the MCID service are permanent mode, where the MCID service is invoked for all incoming communications, and temporary mode, where the MCID service is invoked only for the incoming communications declared by the served user.

documents.title: The difference between the datagram transport mode and the stream transport mode in the context of MPQUIC-IP steering functionality
documents.text: In the datagram transport mode, data packets are transferred inside QUIC DATAGRAM frames, while in the stream transport mode, data packets are transferred inside QUIC STREAM frames.

documents.title: The eNodeB can forward the Attach Complete message to the new MME
documents.text: The eNodeB can forward the Attach Complete message to the new MME in an Uplink NAS Transport message, and uplink packets can be sent towards the eNodeB, which will then be tunnelled to the Serving GW and PDN GW.

documents.title: The types of triggers that can be used for data collection and analytics
documents.text: The types of triggers for data collection and analytics include immediate, time period, location, network performance, NF load, UE status, UE performance, application status, and application performance.

documents.title: The Monitoring Events feature in the 3GPP network allows for event identification
documents.text: The Monitoring Events feature in the 3GPP network allows for event identification, detection, and reporting to authorized users via the SCEF. This feature supports monitoring the association of the UE and UICC, UE reachability, location and change in location of the UE, loss of connectivity, communication failure, roaming status, number of UEs present in a geographical area, availability after DDN failure, and PDN Connectivity Status.

documents.title: The "pros" and "cons" of this solution
documents.text: Pros: This solution enables efficient usage of small IP address ranges per UPF across many SMF, number of IP addresses managed by each UPF may be asymmetrical, low overhead for services with infrequent PDU session establishment patterns, enables direct (user plane) interaction between DN and UPF for IP address management and routing, supports single and multiple IP address reservations by SMF, supports mixed deployments of UPF's and SMF's with release 15 IP address allocation and UPF reservation methods. Cons: Complex IP address management at UPF for large or multiple IP address ranges, increased UPF complexity to manage leftover IP address reservations in otherwise clear IP address ranges, high signalling overhead for frequently used services or services that frequently establish and tear down PDU sessions.

documents.title: One of the potential benefits of applying non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) in NR, particularly in enabling grant-free transmission
documents.text: Non-orthogonal multiple access, particularly when enabling grant-free transmission, may save the scheduling request procedure, reduce UE's power consumption, lower latency, and increase system capacity.

documents.title: The UE will keep re-transmitting the Scheduling Information or UL MAC Control
documents.text: The UE will keep re-transmitting the Scheduling Information or UL MAC Control Information until an ACK is received from the RLS containing the serving cell or the maximum number of re-transmissions is reached.

documents.title: The communication control capability in USAT/Network interaction
documents.text: The communication control capability is a mechanism whereby the use of communication resources is either initiated by the USAT application or modified by the USAT application subsequent to a user action.

documents.title: Definition of the "3GPP"
documents.text: The "3GPP" is a partnership project that works on the technical specifications of mobile communication systems.

documents.title: The expected behavior of the UE in step 3 of the test procedure
documents.text: In step 3 of the test procedure, the UE should send the REGISTER request using an existing set of security associations, if available, and populate a new Security-Client header field within the REGISTER request and associated contact address, set to specify the security mechanisms it supports, the IPsec layer algorithms it supports, and the parameters needed for the new security association setup.

documents.title: The UE will populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request or
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.229 specifies that the UE will populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request or response within a dialog with the current point of attachment to the IP-CAN (e.g. the current cell information).

documents.title: An example of a network service requirement for 5G communication in vertical domains
documents.text: An example is the requirement for clock synchronization, which has specific communication service level and performance requirements.

documents.title: The PCF decrements the PDU Sessions counter for the S-NSSAI and the
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.513 specifies that the PCF decrements the PDU Sessions counter for the S-NSSAI and the counter of UEs per Network Slice only if this was the last PDU Session in the Network Slice for the UE.

documents.title: The main benefit of using the same gNB for serving a transparent satellite before and after the feeder link switch
documents.text: One main benefit is that the gNB can keep the DL reference signals and the cell "alive" during the transition, which might eliminate the need for a HO and reduce interruptions or discontinuities in DL transmissions.

documents.title: The impact of the CLIR Supplementary Service on the CLIP Supplementary Service
documents.text: The CLIR Supplementary Service takes precedence over the CLIP Supplementary Service, unless the called user has an override category.

documents.title: When the AF disables sponsoring a service, the PCRF disables the usage
documents.text: 3GPP TS 29.214 specifies that when the AF disables sponsoring a service, the PCRF disables the usage monitoring for the sponsored data connectivity, regardless of whether the solutions defined in Annex~F are used. This results in PCRF obtaining the accumulated usage of the sponsored data connectivity.

documents.title: The TDP list in the O-CSI is a list of TDP descriptions
documents.text: The TDP list in the O-CSI is a list of TDP descriptions that contain the DP value, gsmSCF address, serviceKey, default call handling, and DP criteria.

documents.title: The UE should wait for the local release of the established NAS
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies that the UE should wait for the local release of the established NAS signalling connection upon expiry of timer T3440 or T3440 being stopped before proceeding. Alternatively, if the UE receives a request to establish either a CS emergency call or a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, the UE should stop timer T3440 and locally release the NAS signalling connection.

documents.title: Purpose of the test described in section 15.2.3
documents.text: The purpose of the test described in section 15.2.3 is to verify that the ME forwards the RAND and AUTN received in 5G authentication challenge data to the USIM and returns the Synchronization-Failure in the AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message if the verification of AUTN failed due to a synchronization failure.

documents.title: The two structures in which the protocols over the Uu and NG interfaces are divided
documents.text: The two structures are user plane protocols, which implement the actual PDU Session service and carry user data through the access stratum, and control plane protocols, which control the PDU Sessions and the connection between the UE and the network from different aspects.

documents.title: The format of the "UARFCN" field in the "Unsuccessful-UARFCNItem-PSCH-ReconfFailureTDD" sequence
documents.text: The "UARFCN" field is of type "UARFCN," which is a common data type used to indicate a UTRA absolute radio-frequency channel number in the NBAP protocol.

documents.title: The two main service attributes considered in the FRMCS System from a user point of view
documents.text: The two main service attributes considered are latency and communication reliability.

documents.title: During RAN congestion, the network is able to select and allocate sufficient
documents.text: During RAN congestion, the network is able to select and allocate sufficient resources for high priority communications such as the disaster message board service, while allowing continuation of non high priority communications with possibly reduced resources.

documents.title: The SMF should reject the PDU Session Establishment request with a proper
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.503 specifies that the SMF should reject the PDU Session Establishment request with a proper cause value.

documents.title: A SL Positioning Server UE uses SL Positioning Client UE data such
documents.text: A SL Positioning Server UE uses SL Positioning Client UE data such as the location request type, accuracy, client identity, and SL Reference UE ID(s) to determine whether the SL Positioning Client UE is authorized and is authorized to retrieve the location information of the Target UE.

documents.title: Purpose of the receive state array V(N) in a TBF with FANR activated
documents.text: The array V(N) in a TBF with FANR activated indicates the receive status of RLC data blocks that are supposed to follow the block BSN=V(Q)-1. It is indexed relative to the receive window state variable V(Q) modulo SNS.

documents.title: EFADN contains Abbreviated Dialling Numbers, Supplementary Service Control strings, identifiers of associated
documents.text: EFADN contains Abbreviated Dialling Numbers, Supplementary Service Control strings, identifiers of associated network/bearer capabilities, and identifiers of extension records. It may also contain associated alpha-tagging.

documents.title: The UE sends an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the UE sends an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI.

documents.title: The meaning of "shall" in the context of the present document
documents.text: In the context of the present document, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

documents.title: Indicated in the message "Context Acknowledge (ISR Activated)" that the old MME should do with the UE's contexts
documents.text: The old MME should maintain the UE's contexts and stop the timer started in step 3.

documents.title: The potential service requirements for in-network and device caching in the 3GPP system
documents.text: The potential service requirements for in-network and device caching in the 3GPP system include efficient delivery of content from an appropriate caching entity, support for a flexible deployment of content caching entity located at multiple locations within the network, and support for chip charging, Lawful Interception (LI) and QoS differentiation for content delivered from an in-network caching entity.

documents.title: The consequence of sending a DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message with a layer-2 ID conflict
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.554 specifies that the target UE will send a DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the cause value #3 "conflict of layer-2 ID for unicast communication is detected.".

documents.title: Purpose of studying which parts of the 5G system will be affected and in what way by the potential threats
documents.text: The study investigates the impacts of the threats on UE, gNB, and core network entities separately to ensure that 5G systems remain secure also in the future.

documents.title: The agreed threshold for co-existence between UMTS and GSM in the 3GPP UMTS system
documents.text: The agreed threshold for co-existence between UMTS and GSM in the 3GPP UMTS system is that UMTS UL/DL capacity loss due to interferences from GSM UL/DL should not be bigger than 5%.

documents.title: Criterion 1 is fulfilled when the SrxtlevnonServingCell,x of a cell on an
documents.text: Criterion 1 is fulfilled when the SrxtlevnonServingCell,x of a cell on an evaluated higher absolute priority layer is greater than Threshx,high during a time interval Treselection.

documents.title: The Location Type parameter in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message defines
documents.text: The Location Type parameter in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message defines the type of location information being requested.

documents.title: The maximum number of secondary serving HS-DSCH cells that can be active at the same time
documents.text: A maximum of 7 secondary serving HS-DSCH cells can be active at the same time.

documents.title: The UE uses the WLANSP rules from the visited PLMN first, then
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.302 specifies that the UE uses the WLANSP rules from the visited PLMN first, then the valid WLANSP rules from the equivalent PLMN in which the UE last received WLANSP, and finally the valid WLANSP rules from the home PLMN.

documents.title: The S-CCF will select and return only one 200 (OK) response, based
documents.text: The S-CCF will select and return only one 200 (OK) response, based on the operator's policy, such as returning the first 200 (OK) response that was received.

documents.title: The PCF shall provide the "defQosFlowIndication" attribute set to true in order
documents.text: The PCF shall provide the "defQosFlowIndication" attribute set to true in order to indicate that the related PCC rule shall be bound to the default QoS flow.

documents.title: The conditions that enable the source RNC to initiate the Relocation Cancel procedure during or after the Relocation Preparation procedure
documents.text: 3GPP TS 25.413 specifies that the Relocation Cancel procedure can be initiated by the source RNC if it has not yet initiated the execution of relocation of SRNS via the Iur or Uu interface, or if after initiating the execution of relocation of SRNS, the UE returns to the source RNC by transmitting an RRC message indicating that the UE considers the source RNC as its serving RNC.

documents.title: The "3GPP-TS-Buffer" header describes the current available range for PSS time shifting
documents.text: 3GPP TS 26.234 specifies that the "3GPP-TS-Buffer" header describes the current available range for PSS time shifting, and it may use one of three descriptive formats depending on the current state of the time-shift buffer.

documents.title: The MS shall use the received P-TMSI as the new temporary identity
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that the MS shall use the received P-TMSI as the new temporary identity for GPRS services and send an ATTACH COMPLETE message back to the network.

documents.title: The ME is required to support the Proactive SIM
documents.text: The ME is required to support the Proactive SIM: Select Item facility as defined in TS11.14 clause 5, 6.4.9, 6.6.8, 6.8, 12.6, 13.4 and 14.

documents.title: The role of the MC gateway server in the MCVideo system and interconnected MCVideo system
documents.text: The MC gateway server is responsible for relaying call control and floor control signalling messages, and media between MCVideo servers within the MCVideo system and the interconnected MCVideo system.

documents.title: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF no Gx filter operation when
documents.text: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF no Gx filter operation when the TFT operation is "No TFT operation" or the TFT is missing.

documents.title: The updated Partially Allowed NSSAI should be provided within the "partAllowedNssai" attribute
documents.text: The updated Partially Allowed NSSAI should be provided within the "partAllowedNssai" attribute.

documents.title: The MC service client sends the MBS listening status report to the
documents.text: The MC service client sends the MBS listening status report to the MC service server, which may be sent multiple times due to broadcast reception quality level changes. The report includes the current broadcast reception quality level.

documents.title: Definition of the acronym "3GPP" in the document title
documents.text: 3rd Generation Partnership Project.

documents.title: The role of the MCVideo pull from server request in the one-from-server video pull procedure
documents.text: The MCVideo pull from server request is used to initiate the pull of a video from the server by the MCVideo client. It contains the URL of the video file and an SDP offer with media description.

documents.title: The UE can obtain this information from the hosting network by manually
documents.text: The UE can obtain this information from the hosting network by manually selecting a network, using default credentials, or obtaining credentials provided by the hosting network.

documents.title: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission for
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.321 specifies that if the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission for this TTI, and the allocated UL resources can accommodate the Timing Advance Report MAC control element plus its subheader, as a result of logical channel prioritization.

documents.title: The mobile station shall act on the message but shall not accept
documents.text: 3GPP TS 44.060 specifies that the mobile station shall act on the message but shall not accept a PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message, a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message and a PACKET POWER CONTROL/TIMING ADVANCE message addressing the mobile station with the TFI value associated with the uplink TBF.

documents.title: The UE sends a REGISTER message containing an Invoke component of the
documents.text: The UE sends a REGISTER message containing an Invoke component of the DeactivateSS operation with the expected parameter values for deactivation of a specific supplementary service.

documents.title: The UE should not transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH
documents.text: The UE should not transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH, PDSCH, TRS, CSI-RS for tracking or CSI-RS for CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP.

documents.title: The mobile station should indicate this priority level to higher sublayers and
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that the mobile station should indicate this priority level to higher sublayers and store this information for the duration of the call for further action.

documents.title: The procedures that should be supported at the II-NNI for Inter-UE transfer (IUT)
documents.text: The REFER request, including a Refer-To header field with a body parameter and a Replaces header field, should be supported at the roaming II-NNI. The NOTIFY requests containing a "sipfrag" MIME body should be supported at the II-NNI, as well as the "g.3gpp.iut-controller" media feature tag in the Accept-Contact header field.

documents.title: The initial condition of the mobile station in this test
documents.text: The mobile station is GPRS attached and in packet idle mode, with PDP context 1 having been established.

documents.title: The NEF shall interact with the PCF for MBS policy authorization of
documents.text: The NEF shall interact with the PCF for MBS policy authorization of the received updated MBS Service Information and the update of the corresponding MBS Application Session Context.

documents.title: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT or PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
documents.text: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT or PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT.

documents.title: Functions of the protocols that are part of the NAS
documents.text: The NAS supports the mobility of the user equipment and the support of session management procedures to establish and maintain IP connectivity between the UE and a PDN GW.

documents.title: If a mobile station is unable to synchronize to the old cell
documents.text: If a mobile station is unable to synchronize to the old cell or if timer T3176 expires, the mobile station should cancel the sending of the PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message and perform an autonomous cell re-selection.

documents.title: The trigger for event A6 in the 3GPP specification
documents.text: The event A6 is triggered based on the entering condition defined as Mn + Ocn - Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighboring cell, Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbor cell, Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, Ocs is the cell specific offset of the serving cell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Off is the offset parameter for this event.

documents.title: The P.NATS quality model is composed of separate modules for estimating audio
documents.text: The P.NATS quality model is composed of separate modules for estimating audio and video quality, and combines them with stalling events that may have occurred on the client. The model is modular, allowing quality estimation to be separated into a server-side estimation of audio and video coding quality and a client-side integration of coding quality in combination with stalling events. The sampling frequency for the audio and video quality estimation module output is 1 Hz.

documents.title: The SDCF assigns a charging key per sponsor basis, and the charging
documents.text: The SDCF assigns a charging key per sponsor basis, and the charging key is included in the charging data record (CDR) sent to the OFCS.

documents.title: The Extended Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE is used if the range
documents.text: The Extended Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE is used if the range of the Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE is insufficient to represent the value of the Reference E-TFCI Power Offset to be sent to the Node B.

documents.title: REGISTRATION
documents.text: REGISTRATION.

documents.title: The UE should assume the first 3 OFDM symbols are occupied by
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.213 specifies that the UE should assume the first 3 OFDM symbols are occupied by control signalling, no resource elements used by primary or secondary synchronization signals or PBCH or EPDCCH, CP length of non-MBSFN subframes, redundancy version 0, and the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to CSI-RS EPRE as given in Clause 7.2.5.

documents.title: Purpose of the scene-based audio capture device in this process
documents.text: The scene-based audio capture device is used to estimate the sound pressure at the geometric center of the free-field volume and periphonic loudspeaker array.

documents.title: The NDS/IP security mechanism or a proprietary security mechanism is used for
documents.text: The NDS/IP security mechanism or a proprietary security mechanism is used for mutual authentication and to protect the communication between the MTC security GW and the MTC server when the MTC server is located outside the operator's domain.

documents.title: The finest granularity for QoS forwarding treatment in the 5G System
documents.text: The finest granularity is 5G QoS Flow.

documents.title: The common parameters included in each xIRI in the PTC Server
documents.text: Each xIRI in the PTC Server includes at a minimum the following information: Target identity, Time stamp, Correlation information, Location information (if required and available), PTC related information (e.g., PTC group ID, PTC party), Encryption parameters (if required and available), and Direction (floor control source or destination port).

documents.title: The MS should attempt to interpret the message and act on it
documents.text: The MS should attempt to interpret the message and act on it if it addresses the mobile station. It should not transmit a RLC data block in any uplink radio block allocated via the polling mechanism.

documents.title: Use cases are being focused on in the 3GPP project on studying AI/ML for NR air interface
documents.text: 3GPP TR 37.817 specifies that the use cases being focused on in the 3GPP project on studying AI/ML for NR air interface include CSI feedback enhancement, beam management, and positioning accuracy enhancements.

documents.title: The target UE should create a PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message
documents.text: The target UE should create a PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message and pass it to the lower layers for transmission along with the initiating UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication and its own layer-2 ID for unicast communication.

documents.title: The difference between the fixed limit test and the statistical test for the conformance requirement
documents.text: The fixed limit test uses a fixed number of samples and a limit block error rate, while the statistical test uses statistical methods to make an early pass/fail decision, potentially reducing test time.

documents.title: The UE either releases the current N1 NAS signalling connection and attempts
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.122 specifies that the UE either releases the current N1 NAS signalling connection and attempts to obtain service on the higher priority PLMN, or does not release the connection and skips certain steps in the registration process.

documents.title: The impact of IAB on the 5GC in terms of function visibility
documents.text: The IAB operation is invisible to the 5GC in terms of function visibility.

documents.title: The actions taken by the network when it receives a RR STATUS
documents.text: The actions taken by the network when it receives a RR STATUS message from a RR entity are implementation dependent.

documents.title: The MCData client should set the Disposition request type IE to "DELIVERY"
documents.text: The MCData client should set the Disposition request type IE to "DELIVERY" when only delivery disposition is requested.

documents.title: The mobile station takes actions depending on the Location Area Identities (stored
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that the mobile station takes actions depending on the Location Area Identities (stored on SIM/USIM) and the value of the attach attempt counter. If the update status is U1 UPDATED, the stored LAI is equal to the one of the current serving cell, and the attach attempt counter is smaller than 5, the mobile station keeps the update status to U1 UPDATED, and changes the MM state to MM IDLE substate NORMAL SERVICE. If the attach attempt counter is smaller than 5 and the stored LAI is different from the one of the current serving cell or the update status is different from U1 UPDATED, the mobile station deletes LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number stored in the SIM/USIM, and sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED. The MM state remains MM LOCATION UPDATING PENDING. If the attach attempt counter is greater than or equal to 5, the mobile station deletes any information stored in SIM/USIM and performs appropriate MM specific procedures in MM IDLE state or PLMN search state.

documents.title: The function of the TDF in service detection and policy rules definition and structure
documents.text: The TDF performs service detection functions and applies detection and enforcement actions for the specified service traffic based on the information required in the Service Detection and Policy rule (SDPR rule).

documents.title: Definition of the "transceiver array boundary"
documents.text: The transceiver array boundary refers to the point or points at which the transceiver array is connected to the RDN. It can refer to the combination of all the transceivers or an individual transceiver.

documents.title: The goal of the gap analysis between 3GPP SA5 specifications and NGMN Top Operational Efficiency recommendations
documents.text: The goal of the gap analysis is to provide a support status of SA5 specifications against NGMN Top OPE Recommendations, and to describe the SA5 solution when it exists, or consider some action to address the Top OPE recommendation when it is not applicable.

documents.title: In the "ProtocolIE-Container" of the "HandoverRequestAcknowledge" section, "ID id-PDUSessionResourcesAdmitted-List" field contains a
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.413 specifies that in the "ProtocolIE-Container" of the "HandoverRequestAcknowledge" section, "ID id-PDUSessionResourcesAdmitted-List" field contains a list of PDUSessionResources that are admitted in the handover process.

documents.title: The VLR may initiate the MM information procedure by transferring an SGsAP-MM-INFORMATION-REQUEST
documents.text: The VLR may initiate the MM information procedure by transferring an SGsAP-MM-INFORMATION-REQUEST message to the MME if for the target UE for the MM information procedure the state of the SGs association in the VLR is SGs-ASSOCIATED.

documents.title: The procedure for group communication connect over MBS session for MCData service
documents.text: The MCData server initiates the MCData group data request towards each MCData clients. The receiving MCData clients accept or reject the MCData group data request and the corresponding result is in the MCData group data response towards MCData server. The MCData server then sends a MapGroupToSessionStream including the necessary stream information for the MCData clients to receive the MC data related to the group communication which is taken place within the associated MBS session.

documents.title: The UE shall delete the stored Extended local Emergency Numbers List in
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the UE shall delete the stored Extended local Emergency Numbers List in the user equipment.

documents.title: The MS transmits the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the uplink block
documents.text: The MS transmits the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the uplink block specified by the RRBP field when it receives an RLC data block with a valid RRBP field and the FBI bit set to '1'.

documents.title: Purpose of creating a Federated Learning group in the described solution
documents.text: The purpose of creating a Federated Learning group is to coordinate operations among participant NWDAFs when performing federated learning for a given analytics request from any NF.

documents.title: The solution is based on the principles of the 5GS knowing UE/DS-TT
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.501 specifies that the solution is based on the principles of the 5GS knowing UE/DS-TT pairs that can perform UE-UE TSC communication, the SMF and optionally AF knowing VN group information, and the SMF pairing UEs/DS-TTs and reporting port pair numbers to the TSN AF.

documents.title: The goal of solution 24 for key issue #11, "Bidding down attack for NAS based redirection between core networks"
documents.text: The goal of solution 24 for key issue #11, "Bidding down attack for NAS based redirection between core networks" is to establish NAS security between the AMF and the UE to protect the NAS Redirection message and require the UE to only act upon successfully integrity protected NAS Redirection message.

documents.title: The difference between an Information Object Class (IOC) and a Managed Object (MO) in the context of Network Resource Models (NRMs)
documents.text: An IOC is a class that identifies and describes managed objects in an NRM, while a MO is a software object that encapsulates the manageable characteristics and behaviour of a particular Network Resource. The MO is an instance of an IOC, and it has attributes that provide information used to characterize the objects that belong to the class, as well as operations that represent the behaviour relevant for that class.

documents.title: The "NSSAA to be performed" indicator is included in the 5GS registration
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the "NSSAA to be performed" indicator is included in the 5GS registration result IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure will be performed by the network for a network slice.

documents.title: Definition of it
documents.text: When the "5.2.48P /<x>/<x>/OnNetwork/PrivateCall/AllowedCallBackRequest" field is set to "true", the MCPTT user is allowed to request a private call call-back.

documents.title: During compression, the Keyword processor replaces sequences of characters in the input
documents.text: During compression, the Keyword processor replaces sequences of characters in the input stream with keyword dictionary entries as specified by the Keyword Match bit stream.

documents.title: The abbreviation for Network Functions Virtualization in the 3GPP Technical Specification
documents.text: The abbreviation is NFV.

documents.title: The role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the telecommunications industry
documents.text: The 3GPP is an organization that develops technical specifications for the telecommunications industry. The document in question defines the interfaces and Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) for enabling the attachment of synchronous terminals to a Mobile Termination (MT) within the 3GPP system.

documents.title: Definition of the abbreviation "3GPP"
documents.text: 3GPP stands for The abbreviation "3GPP" stands for the "Third Generation Partnership Project".

documents.title: The maximum number of g.3gpp.ussd USSD+xml messages that can be sent in a single SIP INFO request
documents.text: Only one g.3gpp.ussd USSD+xml message can be sent in a single SIP INFO request.

documents.title: The number of attempted session establishments refers to the total number of
documents.text: The number of attempted session establishments refers to the total number of session establishment procedures initiated by BBERF, regardless of the outcome, while the number of successful session establishments refers to the number of session establishment procedures that were initiated by BBERF and resulted in a successful establishment.

documents.title: The primary function of the Transport Network Control Plane in the context of UMTS
documents.text: The Transport Network Control Plane is responsible for the transport bearer management in UMTS.

documents.title: Purpose of "Remote ID" for UAS
documents.text: Remote ID for UAS allows the identification and tracking of unmanned aircraft during flight, providing regulatory agencies with necessary information.

documents.title: The target eNodeB may request the full UE radio capability information from
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.413 specifies that the target eNodeB may request the full UE radio capability information from the core network. If the full UE radio capability information is not promptly received from the core network, the target eNodeB shall proceed with the UE radio capabilities sent by the source RAN node.

documents.title: The recommended practice regarding antenna sharing between Bands 5 and 29 and other specific bands
documents.text: It is recommended that Bands 5 and 29 BS transmitters do not share the same antenna with Bands 4, 12, 17, 30 or 41 BS receivers, unless the antenna path meets very stringent 2nd and 3rd order PIM specifications. For Bands 12 and 17, there should be little difficulty in combining, but for other bands, it is recommended not to share the same antenna.

documents.title: Some alternatives to the FFT used in the baseband processing of the LP WUR architectures
documents.text: Goertzel filters are an alternative to the FFT used in the baseband processing of the LP WUR architectures to compute signals for one or more tones.

documents.title: The "AccessId" leaf represents an access network identifier
documents.text: The "AccessId" leaf represents an access network identifier. Its absence indicates that the UE can consider any available WLAN access network for the network selection.

documents.title: One of the CIoT functionalities that needs to be evaluated for enabling in 5G CN
documents.text: Equivalent overall functionalities as provided by SCEF for CIoT/MTC, monitoring, small data transmission, additional power saving functions, non-IP data delivery, and inter-RAT mobility support to/from NB-IoT.

documents.title: A requirement for the MCVideo service to support Private Communications Off-Network when a receiving MCVideo User has signed on to the service with multiple MCVideo UEs
documents.text: The MCVideo service shall provide a mechanism for the Private Communication to be set up with the MCVideo UE designated by the receiving MCVideo User to be used for Private Communications.

documents.title: In this case, the network should reject the activation request with cause
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies that in this case, the network should reject the activation request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

documents.title: The Node B shall report the new resource operational state by sending
documents.text: The Node B shall report the new resource operational state by sending a RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message containing a "Service Impacting" Indication when the resource operational state of the HS-DSCH resources has changed.

documents.title: The role of the Media Player in the 5GMSd UE functions
documents.text: The Media Player is responsible for providing functions for accessing media content, such as DASH-formatted media segments, and presenting the media using an appropriate output device enabling possible interaction with the media.

documents.title: When the TBF starting time is in the past, the mobile station
documents.text: When the TBF starting time is in the past, the mobile station is expected to 'immediately' send RLC data blocks.

documents.title: UEs shall implement NIA0, 128-NIA1, and 128-NIA2 for integrity protection and NEA0
documents.text: UEs shall implement NIA0, 128-NIA1, and 128-NIA2 for integrity protection and NEA0, 128-NEA1, and 128-NEA2 for confidentiality protection.

documents.title: The INITIATING MESSAGE for the informationExchangeTermination PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE
documents.text: The INITIATING MESSAGE for the informationExchangeTermination PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is InformationExchangeTerminationRequest.

documents.title: There are four equal-sized code sub-blocks in the M-PBCH transmission, and each
documents.text: There are four equal-sized code sub-blocks in the M-PBCH transmission, and each code sub-block is modulated with QPSK.

documents.title: The function of NRF in the context of NWDAF and AIF
documents.text: NRF is used for the discovery of ML models supported by AIF and related parameters, which is aligned with Key Issue #19: Trained data model sharing between multiple NWDAF instances.

documents.title: A significant consideration in the design of HEVC (single-layer coding) HLS, regarding future extensions
documents.text: Extensibility mechanisms, or hooks, which allow for backward compatibility with earlier versions of the standard.

documents.title: The MS should ignore the message and return a (GA-CSR, GA-PSR or
