documents.text: The MS should ignore the message and return a (GA-CSR, GA-PSR or GA-RRC) STATUS message with the cause 'semantically incorrect message'.

documents.title: The HTTP PUT/PATCH method should be used to update an existing Policy
documents.text: The HTTP PUT/PATCH method should be used to update an existing Policy in the NSCE Server.

documents.title: The results suggest that AMR-WB+ tends to perform better for speech than
documents.text: The results suggest that AMR-WB+ tends to perform better for speech than for music, while Enhanced aacPlus scores better for music at all tested bit-rates.

documents.title: The MS requests for one phase packet access when the purpose of
documents.text: The MS requests for one phase packet access when the purpose of the packet access procedure is to send a Page Response, Cell Update, for a GPRS Mobility Management or a GPRS Session Management procedure.

documents.title: In this case, the IAB-node may perform local rerouting, i.e., select another
documents.text: In this case, the IAB-node may perform local rerouting, i.e., select another BH link by considering only the packet's BAP address or, in some cases, by header rewriting. In this manner, the packet can be delivered via an alternative path.

documents.title: The recommended number of MBSFN areas that an MC service UE that uses MBSFN transmission should be able to support simultaneously on the same RF carrier
documents.text: The MC service UE that uses MBSFN transmission should be able to support eight MBSFN areas simultaneously on the same RF carrier.

documents.title: The MCData server fetches a file by accessing the MCData content server
documents.text: The MCData server fetches a file by accessing the MCData content server over the MCData-FD-5 reference point using the file URL provided by MCData users. It can then ingest the file into the MBSTF for distribution over MBS sessions.

documents.title: The NSCE service area
documents.text: The NSCE service area is the area where the Network Slice Capability Enablement server owner provides its services, equivalent to the collection of coverage area of slices it can enable.

documents.title: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a
documents.text: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

documents.title: The UE should include "Cell Identity", "CSG Identity", and "CSG Member indication"
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.331 specifies that the UE should include "Cell Identity", "CSG Identity", and "CSG Member indication" and set the indication to "member" if the concerned cell is a CSG member cell.

documents.title: The software package and the artifacts within the package of a virtualized
documents.text: The software package and the artifacts within the package of a virtualized 3GPP NF containing sensitive information should support confidentiality protection. Solutions to this requirement are required outside 3GPP.

documents.title: Purpose of the Gs interface in the 3GPP system
documents.text: The Gs interface in the 3GPP system provides a reliable transfer of signalling messages between the Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN) and the Visitors Location Register (VLR) for coordination between GSM circuit switched services and GSM packet data services.

documents.title: Requirement specifies the spurious emissions for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC in TS 38.101-3
documents.text: The requirement is specified in clause 7.9B.2 of TS 38.101-3.

documents.title: The main motivation for the use of Peer-to-Peer technology in content distribution services
documents.text: The main motivation is to alleviate the need for a linear increase in the number of media servers and to reduce the demands on backbone IP network bandwidth by spreading traffic across the edge of the network.

documents.title: The UE must perform an emergency registration prior to sending the SIP
documents.text: The UE must perform an emergency registration prior to sending the SIP request related to the emergency call if the user initiates an emergency call and emergency registration is needed.

documents.title: Purpose of the sidelink HARQ NACK-only operation in NR-V2X groupcast services
documents.text: The purpose of the sidelink HARQ NACK-only operation in NR-V2X groupcast services is to create a lower sidelink resource demand when a larger number of Rx UEs need to send feedback to the same Tx UE. This operation is useful in scenarios such as extended sensors, where re-transmission will occur if any UE fails to decode successfully.

documents.title: The role of the SCC AS in step 4~6 of 6.5.3.7.4
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.237 specifies that the SCC AS determines the ATCF that UE-1 used for IMS registration based on the STN-rSR and roaming agreement, derives a dynamic STN pointing to the ATCF and responses to the SIP INVITE request with the dynamic STN to UE-1.

documents.title: They should conform to the requirements set out for NE CA certificates
documents.text: They should conform to the requirements set out for NE CA certificates in clauses 6.1.1 and 6.1.4b of TS 33.310.

documents.title: "InitiatingMessage" is a choice within the definition of M3AP-PDU, and it represents
documents.text: "InitiatingMessage" is a choice within the definition of M3AP-PDU, and it represents a message that initiates a new procedure.

documents.title: The SMF rejects the PDU session establishment with a cause indicating that
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.501 and TS 23.502 specifies that the SMF rejects the PDU session establishment with a cause indicating that USS authorization is required.

documents.title: The transaction identifier used on the new MM connection shall be different
documents.text: The transaction identifier used on the new MM connection shall be different to that used on the old MM connection.
